Hello. Ken Burns here.
I've spent five decades making films that tell the stories of America’s greatest challenges -- from the Civil War to the Dust Bowl, from the Second World War to the Vietnam War.
In each of these historic moments, we were challenged to live up to the essential promise of our nation: preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
Today, challenges to our republic are rampant once again. The democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
But this election is not just about keeping Donald Trump out. It's about coming together to protect our shared American values and restoring integrity to our government. That's why electing leaders to the Senate that we can be proud of is so important – and why we have to help Elissa Slotkin hold Michigan's Senate seat for Democrats this fall.
There is also a personal connection in this race for me. Like Elissa, I grew up in Michigan. And she’s a student of history, which I so appreciate in an elected official.
I'd really like to make sure she wins her Senate race this November. So I am asking:
[**Can I count on you to contribute $5, $20 or whatever feels right to you today directly to Elissa Slotkin's Senate campaign in Michigan? Can I tell you a story about my family farm?
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91720750/494789718/417329036?refcode=em20240828pm2-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=602e2a19-9f65-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MDJlMmExOS05ZjY1LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qtnF_JlEc5EhlQ8AbVx3X6gzo0xWbd2T6rscgl2DlG4=)
In 1910, my grandfather came to Montana. He found a piece of grassy land, took a look at it, and said, “This is the place.” And that’s where the farm began.
He farmed the land until the early 1940s, and then passed it down to my folks. In 1978, my wife Sharla and I took over the farm and we’re still here today, three generations and more than 40 years later.
We’ve made a lot of progress here — Sharla and I built a new home, several steel buildings, and more storage.
The truth is, I love this work. Yes, it makes for early mornings and late nights during planting and harvest seasons — but it also keeps me grounded, and it gives me perspective on the issues we face every day.
When I think about climate change, I’m thinking of folks on farms like mine, struggling with catastrophic droughts or historic levels of flooding. When I think about reforming the USPS, I’m thinking of the people in rural communities across Montana who rely on timely mail delivery for their medication or Social Security checks. And when I think about infrastructure, I’m thinking of the rural towns near mine that need access to affordable, high-speed internet.
**These aren’t abstract issues or talking points. They’re very real challenges that deserve real solutions, and that’s what I’m fighting for in Washington. I spend every single day trying to do right by working families, farmers, students, and veterans here in Montana and across the country.**
**[I’m running for reelection because there’s still work to be done. Just like my parents and grandparents on the family farm, when I commit to something, I see it through. I’ll leave you with one last truth about farming: Some years you get the right amount of rain, and things work out really well. Other years, you get a whole lot less.
That means it’s important to be prepared for any outcome, and to have a support system by your side when things get difficult. We don’t know what this campaign will look like, or what Republicans will throw our way over these final few months. But with your support, we’ll be ready.
I appreciate anything you’re able to pitch in. Thanks for your help, and I hope I make you proud.
— Jon

body:

---
Friends, I spoke to the Democratic National Convention about my service in the Marines, how that made me who I am today, and why I am running for U.S. Senate. [**And now, I am asking you to make a split donation to my campaign — to defeat Trump and Kari Lake in Arizona and defend all the progress we have made together and Fight for Reform to help them elect state and local Democrats. Please, if you can afford it, chip in by using this link.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/49501?t=7&akid=21950%2E4449941%2Eo-zDna) | [DONATE $10 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/49501?t=8&akid=21950%2E4449941%2Eo-zDna)
---
My unit was the hardest-hit Marine battalion of the entire war. But the fight didn’t end there.

Instead, my brothers and I found that we had a whole other fight ahead of us: The fight to get the care we were promised. The care we earned.

But I never lost hope. I took on the work myself. I figured out how I could get my guys recognition, their services, their disability payments. I went to Congress to change the system, to make sure it lived up to the promises we make to the people who serve, and to their families.

I slept by a burn pit while I was in Iraq, and countless others did the same. Guys I deployed with, healthy, strong guys, came down with serious illnesses because of those burn pits.

After a long, tough fight, we passed the PACT Act to provide benefits for veterans with those toxic exposures. And now, more than a million veterans from multiple generations are finally getting the help they need.

Trump had four years to get that bill done, and he didn’t. He dodged the draft himself and made some other guy take his place. He called fallen Marines from World War I buried in France “suckers” and “losers.” Just last week, he insulted the few who earned our nation's most sacred military honor, the Medal of Honor.

He and Kari Lake want you to believe our military and our veterans have no greater champion. But they don’t care about us. Theirs is the same record that landed my guys back home needing to scrape and claw for PTSD treatment, for health care, for basic dignity.

They have no place leading this nation, and after all the progress we have made together over the last few years, it is on us to do everything we can to defeat them.

That’s what I told the audience at the Democratic National Convention, and that is why I am running for U.S. Senate in Arizona.

But I can’t do it alone. In everything I’ve accomplished in life, I’ve always had a team behind me. You are a critical part of that team.

And today, I need your help.
[**Please, split $10 to my campaign and Fight for Reform to help them elect state and local Democrats. Trump is rallying his supporters alongside Kari Lake, and we have to raise a ton of resources to defeat them and defend Arizona.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/49501?t=9&akid=21950%2E4449941%2Eo-zDna)
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Fight for Reform and Ruben Gallego will go through immediately:

[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zq9s347qbbl8njq3got3pja95ag5ke0ig0sgio1g_)

Upon returning from Iraq, J.D. Vance pursued higher education with the same tenacity he had shown throughout his life. He graduated from Ohio State University and went on to earn a law degree from Yale Law School, one of the most prestigious institutions in the country. J.D.'s rise from humble beginnings to the heights of academic and professional success is a powerful example of the American Dream, proving that through hard work and determination, anyone can achieve greatness in this great nation.
**[SUPPORT TRUMP-VANCE](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z4aidb6d6o6f3i41pftmkvus93s9ltm0peglcmc8_)**
---

* * *

[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zqikb7vsq5lgg4c6ilt0f5rp5qvio52ahq4tm518_)

In 2016, J.D. Vance published his bestselling memoir, *Hillbilly Elegy*, which resonated with millions of Americans across the country. The book not only told the story of his own life but also shed light on the struggles of working-class Americans in the Rust Belt. J.D.'s ability to articulate the challenges faced by many in forgotten communities made him a prominent voice in conservative circles, as he championed the need for policies that uplift and empower all Americans.
**[SUPPORT TRUMP-VANCE](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z3ct5hvlp7lo3u8s79qlc3ci5042idcu1h8pkbao_)**
---

* * *

[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zqnmt55cej3eo8ts8us82d2oo9sjgskjuv8uolo0_)

**[SUPPORT TRUMP-VANCE](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zak7uhc8m7jamhv79t5ing0m55va72e00m0josh8_)**
---

* * *

[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zhcdcm9ojeh8gnigvfqeu645peshvpdrt8vtq53g_)

In 2022, J.D. Vance was elected as the United States Senator from Ohio, representing the values and interests of the people of his state with courage and conviction. As a senator, J.D. has been a staunch advocate for conservative principles, fighting against big government overreach and championing policies that protect American jobs, strengthen our borders, and ensure that our nation remains the land of opportunity for all.
**[SUPPORT TRUMP-VANCE](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zeombep1rbfr8a9dmtl4njmn55q5drkp9scet948_)**
---

* * *

[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z1h7jhmgngq7dr6qhnqpovpbvcud94lddkp5v3vg_)

Fast forward to July 15, 2024: J.D. Vance is selected as Donald Trump's running mate for Vice President of the United States. With his deep roots in the heartland, military service, and a track record of advocating for the working-class Americans who have felt left behind, J.D. is the perfect complement to Trump's America First agenda. Together, they represent a powerful force for change, ready to restore American greatness by standing up for the values of faith, family, and freedom that define our nation.
**[SUPPORT TRUMP-VANCE](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z12s5vsvp3tsmav4sqej8qpf0hi9rr59f45ogsu0_)**
---

* * *

[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zh4bkiefsfr7l2kl779fih56s6t38mi0iilq5qs0_)

body:
Peter,I'm excited to share something important with you today--**our very first video ad**! This isn't just another campaign video; it's a statement about the kind of leadership and expertise we desperately need in Congress.**I 'd ask you to take 60 seconds to watch it and if you can, please consider chipping in a few dollars to help us get it on the air in the Chicagoland media market.** [](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sojukl-tlidtddjku-r/) The 10th District deserves a representative who is genuinely connected to the community and is a proven leader who understands the importance of practical solutions and putting people first. **That 's why I'm running**. In this ad, you'll see exactly what sets me apart from the rest: **I 'm a father with kids in public schools and I have a fresh, independent, business perspective that I will bring to Washington, grounded in real-world experience and a deep compassion for the challenges our families face. **But here's the reality: **reaching voters with this message isn 't easy, and it isn't cheap**. Running ads on TV, digital platforms, and radio to get our message out to every corner of our district--especially to those pockets that have been forgotten by Washington--is an expensive endeavor. **The costs of voter outreach are high, but the stakes are even higher. Our opponent is already on the air with his video ads, and we need every dollar we can get to counter his big government, partisan, San Francisco policy messaging.****Can we count on your support today to help us make a bigger impact?** Whether you can contribute $15, $25, or more, every dollar will go directly toward ensuring that voters across our District know they have a choice--a choice to vote for someone who brings common sense, compassion, and independence to the table. [PLEASE DONATE $15 TODAY](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sojukl-tlidtddjku-y/) Together, we can make sure that every voter knows they have an option this November - an option for real, practical leadership that listens to the people and works for the families of the 10th Congressional District.Thank you for your support, Jim Carris [](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sojukl-tlidtddjku-j/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sojukl-tlidtddjku-t/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sojukl-tlidtddjku-i/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sojukl-tlidtddjku-d/) [ Share ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-fb-sojukl-tlidtddjku-h/) [ Tweet ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-tw-sojukl-tlidtddjku-k/) [ Share ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-li-sojukl-tlidtddjku-u/) [ Forward ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.forwardtomyfriend.com/t-tlidtddjku-FE53F914-sojukl-l-o) | [Unsubscribe](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-u-sojukl-tlidtddjku-m/)

# Empowering Parents with School Choice: Unleashing the Potential of Education
By Mark Robertson, Candidate for Nevada's First Congressional District
---
Peter,
Lesly and I have four children, two of whom are teachers and two of whom are married to teachers. Both Lesly and I were teachers, so we know the importance of education. The education system is crucial in preparing the next generation for success and innovation in today's rapidly evolving world. However, the one-size-fits-all approach to education fails to meet individual students' unique needs and preferences. Advocating for school choice is about empowering parents and recognizing that every child deserves the best possible education tailored to their specific requirements. By allowing parents the freedom to choose the educational institution that best suits their child, we can foster healthy competition, drive performance improvement, and ultimately elevate the quality of education for all. The Right to Choose As an advocate of school choice, I firmly believe that parents should have the right to decide about their child's education. Just as no two children are identical, no two schools are identical. Parents understand their children's personalities, learning styles, and aspirations better than anyone else. By granting them the right to choose, we acknowledge the vital role of parents as primary stakeholders in their children's education and respect their expertise in making the best choices for their future. Education Dollars Should Follow the Child In a fair and just society, education dollars should be directed to the school of the child's parent's choice. The current system often allocates funds based on a child's zip code, limiting their access to quality education. School choice empowers parents to direct funding to institutions that align with their child's unique needs, preferences, and academic goals. By doing so, we ensure that each child is afforded the same opportunity to succeed, regardless of their socio-economic background. The Power of Competition Competition is the driving force behind progress and improvement in any field, and education is no exception. When parents are granted the freedom to choose among various schools, a competitive environment is created, motivating educational institutions to continuously enhance their programs, curricula, and teaching methodologies to attract more students. School Choice Improves Performance Numerous studies have indicated that competition in education leads to improved performance across the board. Let's review some compelling statistics that shed light on the positive impact of school choice: 1. Academic Achievement: According to a study by the Friedman Foundation for Educational Choice, 31 out of 33 empirical studies found that school choice improves academic outcomes for participating students. They consistently outperformed traditional public school peers regarding test scores and graduation rates. 2. Parental Satisfaction: A report by the National Bureau of Economic Research revealed that parents who had the opportunity to choose their child's school reported higher levels of satisfaction and engagement in their child's education. 3. High School Graduation Rates: A study published by the Journal of School Choice found that students who attended private schools through voucher programs had significantly higher high school graduation rates than their peers in public schools. 4. Increased Efficiency: An analysis conducted by the CATO Institute reported that states with greater school choice programs tend to demonstrate increased efficiency in education spending, indicating that competition fosters resource optimization. Conclusion School choice is not about dismantling the public education system but rather about augmenting it with a diverse array of options that cater to the unique needs of individual students. Empowering parents with the freedom to choose the best educational setting for their children allows competition to thrive, raising the performance bar for all schools. As we advocate for school choice, let us envision a future where every child can access an education that nurtures their full potential, preparing them to become active contributors to society and driving positive change in the world. As your representative in Congress, I will fight for school choice! Decisions about a child's education should be made as close to that child as possible, preferably by the parents, not some bureaucrat in Washington, DC. *******
---
Your Questions--Mark's Answers
Mark Robertson answers your questions with direct and honest answers. Here are two questions Mark was asked recently:
Q: Is the United States' relationship with Israel important, and if so why? A: Yes! Israel is our strongest ally and the only democracy in the Middle East. We are connected in religion, culture, and politics. We share the same goals of peace through strength. We have a moral obligation to support Israel. It is in our self-interest to maintain a strong relationship with Israel. Q: What actions would you take that would allow Americans to retain more of their income and wealth? A: Reduce the size and reach of the federal government so that it stops consuming so much of our nation's wealth. Unleash our energy sector to bring down the cost of oil and gas, reduce inflation, and allow Americans to keep more of THEIR money.
Please share this message with friends and neighbors. Have questions for me? Simply reply to this email to ask me a question.

DeMille designed [the cadet parade uniform](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxszzFvhCAUwPFPA9sZfLxDGBjapG7XtaNBeCgNykU5jd--aefu__yT39djeLiU0zp9uoVsjWVwvqaDBn0DcwMckAcbiYAkJ9t2gEYaNJLPFkPUYaS70wGFVIroLtWIKvjQGqkkTxYEoNBgWiG6VjfS-7sKRJ0mI6IHhoJCqmVrvkta60wxX-WgrfFl4dnOtT53Jt8Y9Az68zyb1-6iO2mcXtdvw6B_z2Vi0H-sdbsY9J3hmw3PM-WcdtUxFNPiUv4b1v95h4WfAAAA__9JkFHr). ## Supreme Court Blocks Biden Loan Plan
The Supreme Court on Wednesday blocked President [Joe Biden's latest student loan relief](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj72OtCAUQJ8GujFwQX4Kiq-xm6_d0iBe9W5QJkoku0-_ma23O8lJTnI-nuMzUqZj_R93DHUpY0yVbhzdA_wD9Kj5HBZEQMUxSAvaK6-94luIBozVztpolDVTVMJAgiR7lE73ceEUQIAWDrwUwkrXqZR6MyNah14sCZgWOFMtZ_dZ6KgbLvmr3Hh2qew8h63W18XUPwYDg6G11k1TejsGw4HtYjDEs1LK-MYE8_p9GCOVLvwM86tRznQZy7RY90j5t1r_frwD_AQAAP__IkxSbg) program, known as SAVE, while legal challenges proceed.The justices upheld a lower court injunction against the plan, which would extend repayment periods and forgive debts of $12,000 or less for millions of borrowers.This decision follows the court's ruling [last year that struck down](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAUAL8Gb1jwIDEMDF28pWtHC8MjocJgAbbVv6_SudtJN5x0X4_lYWOK-flpNzQ9lMW6Hk9cFAVNQS5y8CYgAooBDZ9AaqGlFsPLOOu1mpQOjGsOwd_4KpxmQdxWWIW7D9EAA8kUaM7YxNUonLvdPeKkULPggEiGPvZSx-8Sc39hSD_lxDq6sg3JvHrfGxEfBGYC83Vdo1tbxqu9PYH5jQTmduwVN6SuHLXTNXrMtPXDY-40FZtpKPUZT8zYGm32RLonmwnMQzV-v2JKsd0nItlzszH9tfv_J04DvwEAAP__EJhi3w) Biden's broader attempt to cancel up to $400 billion in student loans.The SAVE program, which Biden touted as "the most affordable student loan repayment plan ever," has been challenged by Republican-led states arguing the president overstepped his authority.

## Report: Texas Faces Major Home Shortage

As a Californian, I treasure our beloved fast-food chain. This wildly successful business should be a true indicator of California's success and brilliance. Unfortunately, even a business so beloved is not immune to Democrat economic and law enforcement policies. Those same policies bring about headlines such as this: In-N-Out was forced to close its first restaurant ever because of the rampant crime in Oakland. The Democrats who did this to our state and to Oakland should be ashamed. I called for the Oakland Mayor to resign, and I called for Adam Schiff to join me - But unsurprisingly he's silent on the issue. That's because Adam Schiff, Gavin Newsom, and Sheng Thao are all part of the same Democrat machine driving California out of prosperity and into the ground. Friend, I think it's time we go "Animal-Style" on Adam Schiff. Your contributions to my campaign show your support and a complete rejection of the 4-decade Democrat-Rule in California. They fund our extensive door-knocking campaigns - pay for impactful ads - and help me travel across the state getting in touch with my supporters and speaking as much as I can to Californians encouraging them to cast off the Democrat malaise. | | | | | | | Your support means the world to me. subject: This made me feel hope today
body:
Meet Asia, one of the new faces of the clean energy economy
| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2807084/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
---
| Hi there,

I want to introduce you to someone I had the absolute pleasure of meeting recently. Her name is Asia, and she represents opportunity and hope for our climate, workers, and future.

Asia went from a grueling job at Amazon to a job she loves thanks to a hands-on workforce development program, an apprenticeship with one of the oldest, most successful unions in the U.S., and lots of hard work in between.

Her pathway from training program to a career-track, good-paying union job is the same model that the American Climate Corps is championing. **That means there could be thousands of more success stories like hers in the years to come.**

But don't take it from me. [**Hear her story firsthand and get ready to feel inspired.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2807085/87SdQ4wZ) |
---
[WATCH THE VIDEO](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2807086/87SdQ4wZ)

---
| Asia is doing work she loves, has big goals, and is proud to be one of the new faces of our growing clean energy economy. I hope her story brings a smile and a bit of hope to your day, just like it did to mine.

Kindly, |

|
# Embracing Faith and Fostering Unity

**Peter -**
Reflecting on the significance of engaging where communities gather, particularly in places of faith, and the warm welcome I've received, I wanted to share this personal insight. [**But before delving deeper, I'm reaching out to ask for your support by considering a donation to our campaign today. Your contribution could truly make a profound impact on our efforts for Texas's 8th district.**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=0cb9ce5bf2&e=a2a46ff12c)
In my pursuit as a candidate for US Congress in Texas's 8th district, I've made connecting with people a cornerstone of my mission. One significant place where communities converge is within places of worship. Engaging in worship services has provided me a connection to the community.
---
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=41e0b1eec2&e=a2a46ff12c)
|
However, growing up in a deeply sheltered and religious environment, I navigated my own path, ultimately encountering challenges in adulthood. Revisiting church posed initial hurdles, but as a political candidate, I recognized the importance of engaging where people gather.
---
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=17ee5cd2c5&e=a2a46ff12c)
| Venturing into various places of worship, I've been warmly received despite some differing political perspectives. This experience reshaped my view of the purpose of church, reinforcing my belief in the unifying strength of shared goals and unity.
---
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=5202b1dc2c&e=a2a46ff12c)
| Despite our diverse backgrounds, our common love for the community unites us in our joint efforts to aid those in need.
I am grateful for the life I lead, my wonderful neighbors, and the community I am honored to serve. Your warm welcome inspires me to remain engaged and present in every community. Let’s keep working towards a better district here in TX-8. Thank you for your ongoing support.

[**The people of District 8 and communities throughout it are deserving of compassionate, fair representation. I am ready to be a part of that representation. If you can stand by me in this and chip in today, I would appreciate it so mu**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=54ca812639&e=a2a46ff12c)**ch.**
---
[Support This Campaign!](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=acdf559e6e&e=a2a46ff12c)
| Thank you for listening and learning a little more about me and why this means so much.

\- Laura

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: My decision.

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1839%2E135344%2Ev_-7pG)

[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240829-1-900&t=2&akid=1839%2E135344%2Ev_-7pG)
---
Friends --
While I know our campaign has sent a lot of emails recently, I want to take a few minutes to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place, and why your support is so important in our success.
The truth is, we all know America is _going through something_ right now. We seem to be living from crisis to crisis. But there are certain things that should be really simple:
Like living a middle-class life in the state that invented the middle class.
Like making things in America so that we’re in control of our own economic security.
Like protecting our children from the things that are _truly_ harming them.
And preserving our rights and our democracy so that our kids can live their version of the American dream.
**I’m running for Senate because I believe that we need a new generation of leaders that thinks differently, works harder, and never forgets the mission of public service.**
But my decision to run for Senate is also deeply personal to me, and it's related to what motivated me to first run for the House in 2018.
It's about my mom, Judy. She was diagnosed with stage IV ovarian cancer in 2009 — and didn't have health insurance at the time. She had let it lapse after the insurance companies had gouged her for years because she happened to have a pre-existing condition. She passed away in 2011, but that experience — of desperately trying to get her care at the same moment we were filling out bankruptcy paperwork — fueled me to run. I remember the exact moment that made me run: when the then-GOP controlled House of Representatives, the body I now serve in, voted to repeal those protections for people with pre-existing conditions.
Seven years later, the Republican leaders, fueled by the extreme wing of the party, are continuing the march to repeal things that the average Americans want. They want to privatize Social Security and Medicare, repeal drug price protections like allowing Medicare to negotiate, then there’s the rights they’re obsessed with repealing: a woman’s right to choose, voting rights, and any possible gun safety legislation.
By winning this Senate seat, we’ll help ensure that Democrats retain the (slight!) majority and can pass legislation that expands access to healthcare. Not the obsession with taking things away.
To be upfront: **Winning this race is going to take a lot of resources. A crazy amount. And we have to do it without raising a single dollar from corporate PACs.**
[**That is why I would love it if you would consider donating $3 or whatever you can to my campaign as we're now in the final sprint of this campaign.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240829-1-900&t=3&akid=1839%2E135344%2Ev_-7pG)**

subject: Trump broke the law by filming a campaign ad at Arlington National Cemetery. Sign to demand he be punished
body:

| | |
# [Demand Trump apologize to veterans and be punished for his disgraceful performance at Arlington National Cemetery](https://default.salsalabs.org/T80ede7a7-2c2d-4634-9213-42074ccd2c79/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T94a4081a-4d25-479e-83a0-77f675aa5331/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | | It takes a special kind of jerk to go to the sacred space of Arlington National Cemetery, use it as a campaign prop, and flash a thumbs up in front of a tombstone while illegally taking pictures and film for ads. **Donald Trump is that jerk. And it's not surprising that veterans across America are [livid](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tac7c38f0-9a75-4930-b33a-d323f0296abf/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9).** Trump needs to apologize, and he needs to do it immediately. And since what he did is against federal law, according to cemetery officials, he needs to be punished. If Trump really cared about the grieving families who were there, as he claims, he wouldn't have used them as campaign props. There's no excuse for this, and he needs to admit what he did was wrong, and face the consequences. Friend,

This past week, I’ve been in Taiwan laying out what America must do to deter China’s aggression.

https://click.updates.nikkihaley.com/?qs=037ba1a82589ea233ee80ab1445a8b12db62e3f3f6d8a90d55d13bb24c6dc1cf6ebf5d6f3200b14b99ce2f95b6f3f4c6a0d41974522b105598e697c8b60569ce

https://click.updates.nikkihaley.com/?qs=037ba1a82589ea233ee80ab1445a8b12db62e3f3f6d8a90d55d13bb24c6dc1cf6ebf5d6f3200b14b99ce2f95b6f3f4c6a0d41974522b105598e697c8b60569ce

Taiwan is a free country that wants to defend itself, but we must partner to protect the free world. That includes stopping China's bullying at the UN, protecting our supply chains from China, and making sure Taiwan has the weapons and training they need to deter China.

At the UN, I made clear that I would have the backs of America’s friends—and call out our enemies.

I backed Israel, Ukraine, and many others. When it came to Taiwan, I was shocked to find out that they aren’t even allowed in the building. China has bullied its way into keeping Taiwan out of the UN.

We fought hard to change this. It resulted in a Chinese temper tantrum.

China’s treatment of Taiwan hurts the whole world. In late 2019, Taiwan warned the World Health Organization about a virus coming out of China. But the WHO doesn’t recognize Taiwan, so they downplayed the threat until it was too late, and millions died.

If China didn’t block Taiwan from WHO membership, it would have saved lives. And fewer countries would have crippled their economies and curtailed their people’s freedom.

**
** **_James Carville Smeared My Name for Jon Tester_** __

Fellow American,

Lifelong political hack and Democrat smear artist James Carville had A LOT to say about me in a recent fundraising email:

_He called me a**“snake” and warned readers that I couldn’t be trusted.**_

**He must have seen the poll showing Jon Tester and me neck and neck in the Senate race that will determine the Senate majority. **

He even went so far as to say that my campaign left him _**“F*@%ING TERRIFIED.”**_

[**PUSH BACK ON CARVILLE'S LIES**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=c2d93ba7e5694070aea6772231d70257&_e=VCtL0cZgjn9fKmKVCIvEFidNJ5g-oRWnW9JB3cs-J_4rQezm2Jk77bHB8EdfPLMGp0rvXMp6pObq6DBfzAA-NlRjrgABCrGqicsgRU6ZHalobOm0XQZ7TgDZOsLJ0DbP-_Y1q42KYDcltzt19smfDM3I9sa2IW-3sVCo0_GroaNZyW_Ri7AlSJmaolSVI2UmzinF4emEHjmY6ThWQBhzdtJ7GtfhVlWr2xCmviAMH0Va9Iz8sjOp4ZIlGy5v7_SZiP8tSD5Pv1jFHbfEgYDwTkszr16slkLP5f0NVfq8yiTSw_WSzSpg32mHxNeQeOgyLvCPw5QxRR9XldXMQqZxwpWUb2e4qbmsFNERzB7vJI7UTTXCreE6pHcV0HvHWJCQqu-9TF4fVdzQWao6U3a09A%3D%3D)
_**“His slimy attacks against Jon are working, and now the polls are tightening. This race is wayyyyy too close for comfort!”**_

# [On Hurricane Katrina's 19th anniversary](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=283449&post_id=148264627&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=false&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ4MjY0NjI3LCJpYXQiOjE3MjQ5Mzg1NDksImV4cCI6MTcyNzUzMDU0OSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI4MzQ0OSIsInN1YiI6InBvc3QtcmVhY3Rpb24ifQ.DcFT4Ap3q_WRt1W0auRMJ9b_ClWWj5s6UPG_T8lPz-Y)

Nineteen years ago, I was sheltering at the Best Western in Wiggins, Mississippi with my family as Hurricane Katrina ripped open the world around me.
I was 16 years old, and my mom worked as the manager of the hotel, which was completely booked with people from Pascagoula to Bay St. Louis. Wiggins was a small town, but the first you'd reach heading north from the Gulf Coast, so those evacuating reached our community before anyone else.
Emotions ranged from nervous to grief-stricken as the storm shook the hotel. Most of us knew the storm on top of us would reshape our communities forever.
Everyone was afraid. Except me.
Well, not at first.
I was excited.
I had long been fascinated, even obsessed, with weather. I even forced open the glass doors at one of the exits so that I could go outside and dance in the storm. For the rest of my life I'll be able to boast that I danced in the 150 mph winds of Hurricane Katrina.
My experience turned from enthused curiosity to dread during the many hours the storm hovered over us.
At some point, those in the second floor of the hotel came downstairs and stayed in the first floor hallways. I didn't know why until I went upstairs to get something out of a room and heard the noise.
Howling from every direction, so loud it made it the walls tremble. I thought for sure the roof was going to come off. I thought if Gods were real, and they were angry, this would be the sound of their wrath.
The window sills were bursting with water being forced through the cracks by the wind, like a glass waterfall display, filling the first floor rooms.
When the storm finally passed, we thought the danger was over. We had no idea what was coming next.
Nineteen years later, I still track storms. I dedicated my education and career to understanding hurricanes, and their intimate relationship with global climate.
Since that day, all I've wanted to do is prevent the kinds of tragedies that unfolded during Hurricane Katrina.
Now, after more than four years of searching, I'm finally going back to work in the field that has defined my life since August 29, 2005.
The search has been taxing - applying, interviewing, ghosting. Even for jobs that were custom-made for my skills and experience. Even for jobs where the interviews went perfectly.
No one wants to hire a whistleblower, I thought.
Apparently there's someone that does. And I start work there next week.
[Subscribed](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubWVzb3NjYWxlbmV3cy5jb20vYWNjb3VudCIsInAiOjE0ODI2NDYyNywicyI6MjgzNDQ5LCJmIjpmYWxzZSwidSI6OTA1MDExOTIsImlhdCI6MTcyNDkzODU0OSwiZXhwIjoxNzI3NTMwNTQ5LCJpc3MiOiJwdWItMCIsInN1YiI6ImxpbmstcmVkaXJlY3QifQ.ge3FM6OK4dmUscXn8G7dtxj6j00AdIJCW_a72I9-9NI?)
The Gulf Coast is worse-off today than it was then. Hurricane Ida devastated coastal Louisiana and the Native American tribes who have been living there for thousands of years. Hurricane Ida hit on August 29, 2021 - sixteen years exactly after Katrina.
Our world is not prepared for the myriad of ways in which climate will reshape our lives and communities.
On this solemn day, I am grateful that I'm being put to good use again, doing what I love, doing something that matters, to help those who climate change will not spare.

Venezuelan Gang Expands In Denver
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friend,
We have Venezulan gangs. We have wolves killing our livestock. We have little affordable housing. We can't go skiing, I-70's a mess. We can't enjoy Downtown Denver. We have kids who can't read, write or do math. Yes, Colorado voted for this... With 67 DAYS UNTIL THE ELECTION, it’s time to wake up and make your voice heard -- to vote and help shape the future you want to see in Colorado!
This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, August 29, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|

| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Smrz: Venezuelan Gang Expands In Denver](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JIMMY SMRZ, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Denver is facing an unprecedented threat as the Venezuelan criminal gang Tren de Aragua (TDA) expands its operations into the city. Notorious for its involvement in extortion, kidnapping, and murder, TDA has given its members a “green light” to attack and open fire on Denver police officers, sparking serious concerns about the safety of the city. With local law enforcement already stretched thin by budget cuts and escalating crime, Denver’s Mayor Mike Johnston and the city seem ill-prepared for this threat.
TDA’s influence reaches far beyond Venezuela, where it has operated with impunity, and is now taking root in U.S. sanctuary, cities including New York, Chicago, and Denver. The gang’s barbaric criminality has already surfaced in Colorado, including a violent jewelry store robbery in the Denver Highlands neighborhood this June.
As an understaffed Denver Police Department (DPD) grapples with budget cuts, the city is facing a surge in crime. The question is: Will Denver respond effectively to this growing problem, or will TDA continue to establish a dangerous foothold in the Mile High City?
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

**[Property tax bill passes Colorado House during special session](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)[CBS 11 KKTV](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Colorado Senate gave preliminary approval to a property tax bill aimed at reducing property taxes while maintaining funding for community services. The House had already passed the bill.
* House Republicans acknowledged the bill as a compromise, emphasizing its balanced approach to provide additional property tax relief and protect the Homestead Exemption for seniors, disabled individuals, and veterans.
* Economic experts explained that the bill addresses the significant property value increases in 2021 and 2022, which would have otherwise led to substantial property tax hikes.
* The debate in the House revealed a divide, with some lawmakers viewing the bill as a necessary response to potential larger tax cuts from upcoming ballot initiatives, while others criticized it for reducing local government funding.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Workers on Labor Day say inflation ‘erasing’ American dream, snuffing out hard work](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [WASHINGTON EXAMINER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Heading into Labor Day and the election season, Americans feel disheartened by the economy, with many believing that inflation is undermining their financial progress and the American dream.
* According to a WalletHub survey, 74% of respondents feel that inflation has negated their hard work, and a majority note that their situation seems worse than the previous year despite minor improvements.
* Inflation's impact is so significant that two-thirds of respondents mentioned it would affect their Labor Day plans, and 93% expressed the need for a raise just to keep pace financially.
* Another survey from the Wall Street Journal and NORC highlighted that only 10% of Americans see home ownership, a core component of the American dream, as achievable given the current economic climate.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[US judge tosses machine gun possession case, calls ban unconstitutional](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* A U.S. District Judge in Wichita dismissed a case against a Kansas man charged with possessing a machine gun, declaring the federal ban unconstitutional.
* The decision, influenced by the 2022 Supreme Court ruling in New York State Rifle & Pistol Association v. Bruen, challenges the requirement for firearms laws to align with the nation's historical tradition of firearm regulation.
* The judge, John Broomes, appointed by then-President Donald Trump, found that prosecutors failed to provide a historical analogue to justify the machine gun ban under the new Supreme Court standard.
* The ruling has the potential to be appealed by the U.S. Department of Justice, amid criticism from gun safety groups calling the decision "extreme and reckless."

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Fremont County Commissioners against initiative that would prohibit hunting of mountain lions](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [WASHINGTON EXAMINER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Fremont County Board of Commissioners opposes Colorado Ballot Initiative 91, which aims to ban mountain lion hunting, citing potential increases in human-wildlife conflicts.
* Commissioners argue the initiative, influenced by external groups, could mislead voters and push predators into populated areas, endangering public safety and livestock.
* The board criticizes the initiative for potentially undermining scientific research and effective wildlife management practices conducted by Colorado Parks and Wildlife.
* Concerns are raised that the initiative could negate years of wildlife conservation efforts, affecting the management of mountain lions, bobcats, and lynx.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|

**[Sloan: RFK Jr.’s Trump endorsement redefines the Kennedy legacy](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY KELLY SLOAN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_We have discovered, over these last few months, that even the surname “Kennedy” is no longer adequate insulation against the ire of the current Democratic Party. Stalwart party loyalists and an unsympathetic media never much cared for Robert F. Kennedy Jr’s quixotic attempt to unseat President Biden anyway, but his withdrawal from the race and subsequent endorsement of Donald Trump proved almost too much for some of the more hysteria-prone out there._
_Lawrence O’Donnell, never one for sober analysis or circumspection, called RFK jr. “the Jeffery Dahmer of the animal kingdom” – presumably a reference to his propensity for dumping dead bears in Central Park and cutting up whale carcasses for ease of transport, an activity which has evidently stoked displeasure from environmental groups – and said the he has “horrified his family almost as much as Jeffery Dahmer horrified his family by endorsing the most horrifying Republican presidential nominee in history.” He went on, referring to the Sr. RFK, to talk about “the beatific glow of the name Robert Kennedy, a name which his son has now fully disgraced.” Oh my._

**[Colorado’s Campaign Against Christians Continues](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [NATIONAL REVIEW](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_The state will provide preschool education only to children of parents who are happy to subject them to progressive ideology._
_‘Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.” For many parents, Proverbs 22:6 offers powerful guidance as another school year begins. One group of Catholic parents in Colorado takes this directive to heart and wants to partner with Catholic preschools for the education and formation of their little ones. They are demanding that the state’s universal preschool program allow them to use the public benefit at their schools of choice. It shouldn’t surprise you to learn that the intolerant demands of progressive ideology are at issue._

clean_body: Venezuelan Gang Expands In Denver | | | | PRESENTED BY | | Hi friend, We have Venezulan gangs. We have wolves killing our livestock. We have little affordable housing. We can't go skiing, I-70's a mess. We can't enjoy Downtown Denver. We have kids who can't read, write or do math. Yes, Colorado voted for this... With 67 DAYS UNTIL THE ELECTION, it’s time to wake up and make your voice heard -- to vote and help shape the future you want to see in Colorado! This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, August 29, 2024. – Heidi Ganahl | | | TODAY'S TOP STORIES BY JIMMY SMRZ, Denver is facing an unprecedented threat as the Venezuelan criminal gang Tren de Aragua (TDA) expands its operations into the city. Notorious for its involvement in extortion, kidnapping, and murder, TDA has given its members a “green light” to attack and open fire on Denver police officers, sparking serious concerns about the safety of the city. With local law enforcement already stretched thin by budget cuts and escalating crime, Denver’s Mayor Mike Johnston and the city seem ill-prepared for this threat. TDA’s influence reaches far beyond Venezuela, where it has operated with impunity, and is now taking root in U.S. sanctuary, cities including New York, Chicago, and Denver. The gang’s barbaric criminality has already surfaced in Colorado, including a violent jewelry store robbery in the Denver Highlands neighborhood this June. As an understaffed Denver Police Department (DPD) grapples with budget cuts, the city is facing a surge in crime. The question is: Will Denver respond effectively to this growing problem, or will TDA continue to establish a dangerous foothold in the Mile High City? | The Colorado Senate gave preliminary approval to a property tax bill aimed at reducing property taxes while maintaining funding for community services. The House had already passed the bill. House Republicans acknowledged the bill as a compromise, emphasizing its balanced approach to provide additional property tax relief and protect the Homestead Exemption for seniors, disabled individuals, and veterans. Economic experts explained that the bill addresses the significant property value increases in 2021 and 2022, which would have otherwise led to substantial property tax hikes. The debate in the House revealed a divide, with some lawmakers viewing the bill as a necessary response to potential larger tax cuts from upcoming ballot initiatives, while others criticized it for reducing local government funding. | Heading into Labor Day and the election season, Americans feel disheartened by the economy, with many believing that inflation is undermining their financial progress and the American dream. According to a WalletHub survey, 74% of respondents feel that inflation has negated their hard work, and a majority note that their situation seems worse than the previous year despite minor improvements. Inflation's impact is so significant that two-thirds of respondents mentioned it would affect their Labor Day plans, and 93% expressed the need for a raise just to keep pace financially. Another survey from the Wall Street Journal and NORC highlighted that only 10% of Americans see home ownership, a core component of the American dream, as achievable given the current economic climate. | A U.S. District Judge in Wichita dismissed a case against a Kansas man charged with possessing a machine gun, declaring the federal ban unconstitutional. The decision, influenced by the 2022 Supreme Court ruling in New York State Rifle & Pistol Association v. Bruen, challenges the requirement for firearms laws to align with the nation's historical tradition of firearm regulation. The judge, John Broomes, appointed by then-President Donald Trump, found that prosecutors failed to provide a historical analogue to justify the machine gun ban under the new Supreme Court standard. The ruling has the potential to be appealed by the U.S. Department of Justice, amid criticism from gun safety groups calling the decision "extreme and reckless." | The Fremont County Board of Commissioners opposes Colorado Ballot Initiative 91, which aims to ban mountain lion hunting, citing potential increases in human-wildlife conflicts. Commissioners argue the initiative, influenced by external groups, could mislead voters and push predators into populated areas, endangering public safety and livestock. The board criticizes the initiative for potentially undermining scientific research and effective wildlife management practices conducted by Colorado Parks and Wildlife. Concerns are raised that the initiative could negate years of wildlife conservation efforts, affecting the management of mountain lions, bobcats, and lynx. | BY KELLY SLOAN, We have discovered, over these last few months, that even the surname “Kennedy” is no longer adequate insulation against the ire of the current Democratic Party. Stalwart party loyalists and an unsympathetic media never much cared for Robert F. Kennedy Jr’s quixotic attempt to unseat President Biden anyway, but his withdrawal from the race and subsequent endorsement of Donald Trump proved almost too much for some of the more hysteria-prone out there. Lawrence O’Donnell, never one for sober analysis or circumspection, called RFK jr. “the Jeffery Dahmer of the animal kingdom” – presumably a reference to his propensity for dumping dead bears in Central Park and cutting up whale carcasses for ease of transport, an activity which has evidently stoked displeasure from environmental groups – and said the he has “horrified his family almost as much as Jeffery Dahmer horrified his family by endorsing the most horrifying Republican presidential nominee in history.” He went on, referring to the Sr. RFK, to talk about “the beatific glow of the name Robert Kennedy, a name which his son has now fully disgraced.” Oh my. | The state will provide preschool education only to children of parents who are happy to subject them to progressive ideology. ‘Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.” For many parents, Proverbs 22:6 offers powerful guidance as another school year begins. One group of Catholic parents in Colorado takes this directive to heart and wants to partner with Catholic preschools for the education and formation of their little ones. They are demanding that the state’s universal preschool program allow them to use the public benefit at their schools of choice. It shouldn’t surprise you to learn that the intolerant demands of progressive ideology are at issue. | ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | AUGUST 27 The reason lawmakers in the 74th General Assembly are back in session boils down to one reason, Republican Rep. Dear Fellow Believer,

Countless communities living in isolated parts of the world risk never hearing the gospel.

In these far-off places, not only are people cut off from knowing the good news of Jesus Christ, but they also lack access to essential resources like healthcare, education, and basic supplies.

When you make a gift to Mission Aviation Fellowship, you ensure that no matter the location, **no one is ever out of reach to receive the gospel.**

At Mission Aviation Fellowship (MAF), our airplanes can overcome these barriers of isolation. They are the lifelines that bring help, hope, and healing to the ends of the earth.

**But as a donor-funded ministry, these flights are possible through your support.**

When you give to MAF, your donation fuels our aircraft, equips our pilots, and ensures our planes are ready to respond at a moment's notice. Your support also provides training and resources for local missionaries, helping to spread the gospel even further.

Each flight sponsored by your generosity makes a difference. Whether it's delivering Bibles, transporting medical care, or providing relief supplies, your contribution directly impacts lives and brings the hope of Jesus to those in need.

Will you partner with us in this mission? Click the secure link below to make your gift:

[https://give.maf.org/s/give/da24](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=def9c7d8419c4cf9aa3d19d8ae4c3d73&_e=mKS6GuR6c5gwXJ6mGa9s0vPrzW8TGDJ4Z0xiHpJlwpDiX4M57SXAN3VB6R_qn66YAXf1lV3UtQ0I9lSG9R2k_I_E8T1LMEZg-151yGwYDi0-Nfyt_9KOrOPPunsrMJ9TrND9cxyIzcBmgIyGxg9YcnbRcMWeu_6tOGxBkdzeA9GSaeq2sH9tHluaVKux0Ial8pI_96fZ9ZRYdC3AMYsHUjftVSphbhsuEDjVrxlMryUsENKSBDnI2jEmL_DiyA-S9zZfTxfs7CyqVbhvmKtEcdtqHcYD62ZdiHmnC3bfcgjCtHVCHzS7rMgopatvov3WNN-w6MlhfGUW4bmwqrlF4Q%3D%3D)

Your donation can help us reach those who are otherwise unreachable--providing them with life-saving resources and the love of Christ.

Tracey Werre
Director of Marketing
Mission Aviation Fellowship

# Ian Cain: Conservative, Innovative Leadership
---
| When I first launched my campaign for U.S. Senate, I did so because I saw a void of conservative and innovative leadership. Washington is broken and stuck in the past. It’s time to embrace commonsense policies that propel America into the future. I’m running to usher in a new generation of leadership, where leaders embrace the innovation economy and the new digital world, focus on collaboration instead of divisiveness, and strive for results, not celebrity.
If elected, my promise is simple. **I will get shit done.**
Below are my top priorities when I get to the U.S. Senate:
* End Our Migrant Crisis and Secure our Borders
* Invest in Infrastructure and Build for the Future
* Unleash Economic Potential, End Inflation, and Embrace the Digital Economy
* Protect our Communities and Prioritize Public Safety
* Beat Communist China
* Hold Self-Serving Politicians Accountable and end corruption
* Support American Families

Check out some details on my proposals below.

[](https://cainforus.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d43ce56ef89bc59b1de5a39e8&id=e996e2591a&e=76cb22207d)
| The 42-year-old [Cain](https://cainforus.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d43ce56ef89bc59b1de5a39e8&id=1ce3baff25&e=76cb22207d) believes he represents the next generation of leadership, saying he stands for innovation, energy and connection between the Massachusetts of the past and its future. A graduate of Boston College High School, he attended Boston College and earned an MBA from Duke University.
Cain said he has learned the meaning of public service as a fifth-term Quincy councilor who is now serving as council president.
“That’s where you learn — representing your family, friends and neighbors and knowing what matters to them at the ground level,” Cain said.
Cain has been endorsed by Quincy Mayor Thomas Koch, independent; state Rep. Michael Soter, R-Bellingham, and former Gov. Jane Swift.
Cain said his experience in economic development as a city councilor would inform his work as a senator representing Massachusetts and bring national partners to play on a state and local level.
In his travels across the state, Cain has learned that the migrant crisis is top of mind for most voters. Cain proposes to close the borders, penalize sanctuary cities and allow local police to work with federal immigration authorities to find and relocate those without legal standing in the United States.
The candidate would also take on the Biden administration policy that allows migrants to “parole in place,” which allows a foreign national who is in the country without authorization to stay under certain conditions. Cain refers to the policy as “unlawful parole.”
Cain said he would advocate for asylum reform to ensure migrants are not exploited by unscrupulous actors and require pre-employment verification to ensure job seekers are eligible for employment.
At the same time, he said, “We have to tackle the legal immigration process and streamline it to make it more achievable.
“No one is anti-migrant. Most Massachusetts residents are here through migration."Cain said the second top-of-mind issue for voters is the state’s lack of affordability.While Cain said he favors abortion rights, he agrees with the Supreme Court's Dobbs decision that turned the issue over to the states.

| Peter,

Our private medical decisions are ours and ours alone. That should never be a radical notion.

Should people surrender medical privacy when getting a knee replacement or receiving treatment for breast cancer? _Of course not._

**But that's exactly what anti-abortion extremists and Project 2025 are pushing for when it comes to reproductive care. What they're proposing is nothing short of _complete abortion surveillance._** [**And the Center for Reproductive Rights is doing everything in our power to stop them.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91745307/494855317/2141984067?sourceid=1149789&utm_campaign=25emaab-0804aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=project2025&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0Mzg5MTYwMS0xMDY2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FvETNAM4yUJxculYyMe0RdUdnFJ-Om2gJsOlymwPMyo=&emci=9d634ce2-2f5f-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=43891601-1066-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ceid=954237) | [**PROTECT ABORTION RIGHTS**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91745308/494855318/2141984067?sourceid=1149789&utm_campaign=25emaab-0804aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=project2025&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0Mzg5MTYwMS0xMDY2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FvETNAM4yUJxculYyMe0RdUdnFJ-Om2gJsOlymwPMyo=&emci=9d634ce2-2f5f-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=43891601-1066-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ceid=954237 "PROTECT ABORTION RIGHTS")

It sounds like hyperbole, but it's all too true. The Project 2025 proposal lays out a future where federal funding would be withheld from states unless they reveal the private medical information of every patient who receives abortion care.

[**With your help, we are fighting for reproductive freedom at a time when anti-abortion extremists are criminalizing abortion and prosecuting people who exercise their right to bodily autonomy.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91745309/494855319/2141984067?sourceid=1149789&utm_campaign=25emaab-0804aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=project2025&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0Mzg5MTYwMS0xMDY2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FvETNAM4yUJxculYyMe0RdUdnFJ-Om2gJsOlymwPMyo=&emci=9d634ce2-2f5f-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=43891601-1066-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ceid=954237)

Where Project 2025 can't gut access to abortion and other kinds of reproductive care, they want to choke it out by compromising the safety, security, and privacy of pregnant people.

_The cruelty is beyond words... and all too familiar._

The danger that Project 2025 poses is real, but they’re counting on us to be paralyzed by fear. [**We won't let that happen. Stand with us as we work around the clock to protect the privacy, dignity, and safety of pregnant people.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91745310/494855320/2141984067?sourceid=1149789&utm_campaign=25emaab-0804aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=project2025&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0Mzg5MTYwMS0xMDY2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FvETNAM4yUJxculYyMe0RdUdnFJ-Om2gJsOlymwPMyo=&emci=9d634ce2-2f5f-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=43891601-1066-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ceid=954237)

I know why we didn’t win it.” **As Minnesota Secretary of State, let me be very clear: What he said is not true. In Minnesota, we work to ensure that everyone who’s eligible to vote can vote, that every legal vote is counted, and that whoever gets the most votes wins. That’s not “hanky panky.” That’s democracy.** The former President is entitled to take any position on any issue, but he’s not entitled to repeat provably false statements about our elections in Minnesota. To believe that former President Trump won Minnesota in 2020 would be to believe that more than 100,000 votes were either fraudulent, switched by machines, or otherwise fabricated. That’s ridiculous, not to mention dangerous and poisonous to our democracy. Debating what our election system ought to be is welcome and healthy. **But spreading knowingly false information about its current form is the very definition of disinformation.** [**We must stand up against these dangerous falsehoods, no matter who spreads them. ** Newsletter-Aug 29, 2024 Vol. 4, #39

**

29 August 24

I’m sorry for the delay. I lot has occurred beginning just before the November 2022 election. In October 2022, my father-in-law’s health declined and I began traveling to and from Ohio assisting him until his death on June 4, 2023. Just a few weeks later on June 30, 2023, I was stung and nearly died from the anaphylactic response. It took me until the end of 2023 to recover. A few months later, on February 4, 2024, my father had a serious stroke and I again began traveling to Ohio to care for him until his death on June 1, 2024. Only recently have I been able to resume my “normal” routine. The last 23 months have been a challenging season.

We are now facing one of the most significant elections in our nation’s history. It is clear that the essence of our great republic is at stake. Maryland is set to play a key role in the U.S Congress and the U. S. Senate.

A dear friend of mine of nearly 35 years, Neil Parrott, is running for the U.S. Congress in District 6, western Maryland. Neil’s race is one of the most contested Congressional races and one of the most watched in the nation. We have an opportunity to help Neil prevail.

Larry Hogan is in a statistical tie for the U.S. Senate. I am aware of the concerns some may have regarding Larry. At the risk of oversimplifying, a 40-50% Republican with Larry Hogan is far superior than a 0% Republican (100% Democrat) with Angela Alsobrooks.

I’m asking you to join me in supporting Neil Parrott For Congress. Please walk with Neil and us at the Gaithersburg Labor Day parade on Monday, September 2 (10a-noon).
Please sign up for the parade here.
Neil Parrott Montgomery County volunteers: 2024 Gaithersburg Labor Day Parade (signupgenius.com) (https://www.signupgenius.com/go/20F0F4AAAAA2DA5F49-50635546-2024#/form/Standard)

The parade is a great event with thousands in attendance! It's held in Olde Town Gaithersburg along East Diamond and Russell Avenues. We want a large group to help hand out candy, fans, and stickers.

We will need to line up at 9am at the 400 block of East Diamond Ave. We are #43 in the line up. There will be shuttle buses running from the Lakeforest Mall parking lot from 8-9:30am. Please click on the links for more details.

clean_body: Jeff Warner Is Asking You To Make A Difference! Newsletter-Aug 29, 2024 Vol. 4, #39 29 August 24 I’m sorry for the delay. I lot has occurred beginning just before the November 2022 election. In October 2022, my father-in-law’s health declined and I began traveling to and from Ohio assisting him until his death on June 4, 2023. Just a few weeks later on June 30, 2023, I was stung and nearly died from the anaphylactic response. It took me until the end of 2023 to recover. A few months later, on February 4, 2024, my father had a serious stroke and I again began traveling to Ohio to care for him until his death on June 1, 2024. Only recently have I been able to resume my “normal” routine. The last 23 months have been a challenging season. We are now facing one of the most significant elections in our nation’s history. It is clear that the essence of our great republic is at stake. Maryland is set to play a key role in the U.S Congress and the U. S. Senate. A dear friend of mine of nearly 35 years, Neil Parrott, is running for the U.S. Congress in District 6, western Maryland. Neil’s race is one of the most contested Congressional races and one of the most watched in the nation. We have an opportunity to help Neil prevail. Larry Hogan is in a statistical tie for the U.S. Senate. I am aware of the concerns some may have regarding Larry. At the risk of oversimplifying, a 40-50% Republican with Larry Hogan is far superior than a 0% Republican (100% Democrat) with Angela Alsobrooks. I’m asking you to join me in supporting Neil Parrott For Congress. Please walk with Neil and us at the Gaithersburg Labor Day parade on Monday, September 2 (10a-noon). Please sign up for the parade here. Neil Parrott Montgomery County volunteers: 2024 Gaithersburg Labor Day Parade (signupgenius.com) () Walk ins are welcome. The parade is a great event with thousands in attendance! It's held in Olde Town Gaithersburg along East Diamond and Russell Avenues. We want a large group to help hand out candy, fans, and stickers. We will need to line up at 9am at the 400 block of East Diamond Ave. We are #43 in the line up. There will be shuttle buses running from the Lakeforest Mall parking lot from 8-9:30am. “Farmers and ranchers are affected by climate change,” she said. “The cost of feed is higher than it needs to be. If someone is injured, there’s no hospital close by. And they can’t do telemedicine if they don’t have broadband. I want to fix all that and more.”
“What about the kids?” I said.
“Most kids leave after high school because they can’t earn enough locally,” Trisha said. “Kids shouldn’t have to choose whether to stay with family or leave for opportunity. I’m running to give them a ladder up so they can do both.”
Between Trisha Calvarese and Lauren Boebert, which one do you think cares more about her American neighbors wherever they live?

Budzinski Introduces Legislation to Secure Food Supply Chain, Support Food Workers
“The strength of our food supply chains depends on the support we provide to our grocery, farm and food workers,” said Congresswoman Budzinski.
“The COVID-19 pandemic showed the fragility of our food system and shed light on the challenging conditions faced by our meatpackers and other frontline food workers. As we continue to address supply chain concerns, I’m proud to be introducing bicameral legislation with Senator Sherrod Brown to ensure that our frontline food workers have the safety net they need when these tough and often dangerous jobs face crisis or disaster. I’m so grateful to have the support of my friends at the United Food and Commercial Workers in this important effort and I look forward to providing permanent protections to the folks who help to keep our families fed.”
PITCH IN TO KEEP IL-13 BLUE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/njb-em-aug2024]
Keeping families fed is at the top of Nikki’s list of priorities.
Strengthening our food supply chain will not only ensure that our communities always have access to safe and healthy food, it’ll ensure the workers in the meatpacking and frontline food industries have the safety nets they deserve, and that our farmers are able to continue delivering the food we need to thrive and survive.
But, folks, the GOP is working tirelessly to gut critical food safety nets that so many families across Central and Southern Illinois rely on.

# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=4011%2E552475%2Ey_zzDK)
I believe that no one should go without quality health care because they can’t afford it, Peter — that’s why I’ve been fighting to lower health care costs for Pennsylvanians.
We’ve made great strides over the past few years. From capping the cost of insulin at $35 per month for seniors to allowing Medicare to negotiate drug prices, I’ve fought to make sure all Pennsylvanians have access to affordable, high-quality health care.
But the fight is not over. We still need to expand CHIP and enroll every child in Medicaid at birth, give rural hospitals the resources they need, and keep our Senate majority in Washington to protect the Affordable Care Act.
If we’re going to continue safeguarding and expanding affordable health care, we have to keep Pennsylvania blue.

From capping the cost of insulin at $35 per month for seniors to allowing Medicare to negotiate drug prices, I’ve fought to make sure all Pennsylvanians have access to affordable, high-quality health care. But the fight is not over. We still need to expand CHIP and enroll every child in Medicaid at birth, give rural hospitals the resources they need, and keep our Senate majority in Washington to protect the Affordable Care Act. If we’re going to continue safeguarding and expanding affordable health care, we have to keep Pennsylvania blue. Please use the links in this email to start a weekly donation through ActBlue. With gratitude, Bob Casey

| Peter, Do you ever feel like conservative messages get lost on social media? I feel like that ALL the time! Posts promoting common sense ideas seem to get punished by algorithms. Or worse, it seems like our content is getting outright banned and censored. But they keep claiming it isn’t – that we’re just “imagining” it or that we’re conspiracy theorists. As a member of the Common Sense Majority, it can feel like you’re going crazy with all this gaslighting going on! Well for this week’s nonsense call-out, I have good and bad news for you. The good news: you’re not crazy. **The bad news: ICYMI, We JUST got definitive proof – per Mark Zuckerberg himself – that the federal government has been pressuring social media companies to remove content they don’t like.**
---

|
# Nonsense Call-Out of the Week:
The PROOF is in: Zuckerberg admits he bowed to White House pressure to censor COVID critical content.
---
|

| This week Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg who oversees Facebook admitted to Congress that he and his company [were pressured by the Biden-Harris administration to censor COVID critical posts](https://xtz223.keap-link002.com/v2/click/3a8ad21d2cec4f83c9bdb5e2b9b86b8d/eJyNkE1PwzAMhv9Lzs1KMz6k3qZpmqqOHRCcUZZ6mkXrRIlLV6b-d0xBO4HE1X7exx8XxUCWuGpUqc78YcxSZSqCw4BAvPbE1s1dc3dbLItMtUhv2-j7oMrLr-ErMKfui5tM8RhAkOen1bqu9tvXXbWvhQw2yoz_eR6MuXo2j6tqp6bpTzF0yJt3cSdVcuzh66IG5Sp-ia3wJ-aQyjwfhmFx9OdDn5AgpYXzXR58i4wu5R2w1Q68to3okj5gA6RPNkZMc410iJLqxa0lGSyNwlPyUdsOIjpLSZaxIQA1P5-sYfxeafoE9m2AJw==). Biden, earlier this year that the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) tried to force social media companies to remove content. But now with Zuckerberg’s admission we know that what we suspected all along is reality. The Missouri Attorney General Andrew Bailey, who sued the administration after the state's own content was stifled online called it “the biggest violation of the First Amendment in our nation’s history.” He’s right. The same government that is supposed to protect our free speech is now censoring certain viewpoints. And tech companies are enabling and capitulating. It’s outrageous. Enough with the gaslighting! subject: Aug. 26th CTA: Congrats & Beware the “Experts”
body:
The bureaucracy that locked us down during Covid are extremely close to controlling what our kids get to see and hear.
| | | |

| Patriot-

---
| ******First, our August 22nd Re-Elect Donald Trump Day of Action was nothing short of incredible!** Thanks to you and fellow patriots nationwide, **_tens of thousands of actions were taken_** --from mailing Get Out The Vote postcards to phone banking and lighting up social media with support for Trump. The energy and effort patriots brought are already moving the needle. **But we can 't stop now**--let's keep this momentum going until November 5th!
**ACTION:** **Sign up at[ MarchToVictory.com](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a4a89c5c/1edb9794a4a7b50b "MarchToVictory.com") to keep reaching Trump voters and help us continue the fight to secure Trump's re-election.****** **__****__**
---
| | [ SIGN ME UP ](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a4a89c5c/1edb9794a4a7b50d)
---
| |
---
| ******** Second, we want to alert you to a critical issue currently sitting in Congress--the Kids Online Safety Act (KOSA). At first glance, it might sound like a well-intentioned bill, but don't be fooled.
KOSA would place the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) in charge of deciding what our children can see online, essentially giving the government control over the information and perspectives available to them. The real danger lies in the fact that only content deemed "scientifically correct" by the bureaucracy will be allowed. In reality, this means our kids will be exposed only to the left's worldview--one that says masks are good, our most fundamental rights can be severely restricted whenever politicians say it's necessary, and that boys can become girls, among other ideas with which conservatives vehemently disagree.
If KOSA passes, our children will be permitted to view only what the government-approved experts decide is right. And right now, those experts are pushing an agenda that goes against everything we stand for. It's a direct attack on free thought and the right to access diverse and dissenting perspectives--values we hold dear.Even though the House is out until September, it is crucial that you call and voice your opposition to this bill. The pressure on House members to vote "yes" in the name of "protecting children" will be immense, but we know that this bill is about much more than safety. It's about the left controlling what our children learn and believe. We must help our congressmen find the courage to say no to this dangerous legislation.
**ACTION: Use [our KOSA action page](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a4a89c5c/1edb9794a4a7b50f "our KOSA action page") to quickly send your congressman an email and phone message!** **__****__**

VIKRAM ANNOUNCES "VETERANS FOR VIKRAM" COALITION

---
Today Vikram announced his "Veterans for Vikram" coalition of veterans backing his congressional campaign in NH's Second District.
The coalition is chaired by Air Force veteran Hillary Seeger and State Representative Mike Moffett, Lt. Col. (retired) U.S. Marines. Moffett is also the chair of the Veterans Committee in the NH House.
"While I'm confident that Vikram will be the steady advocate that veterans need in Washington, I also sense that Vikram sincerely wants to honor and remember veterans' personal journeys and the national history they shaped," said Moffett. "That is so important to veterans and their families today."
Seeger added, "I'd become so jaded by party politics. It began to feel like each side had to walk in lockstep with their captors and nothing every got done. I read a book called The Making of a Generalist by Vikram Mansharamani. This book inspired me so much that I decided to run for Congress to get something done for the people of New Hampshire. A friend of mine apologized and said that he wouldn't be supporting me because he was going to support Vikram! The same Vikram who wrote the book! It made more sense to support the person who inspired me so that's what I'm doing. In the military, we were all motivated to be there for different personal reasons. We were from different backgrounds, we had different personal goals and yet, we managed to work together to function as a team. Congress is not doing that. They are two separate warring factions on a battlefield and we the people are that battlefield. I believe that Vikram will go to Washington not to advance his own personal standing, but to address our needs and our legitimate concerns as taxpayers. He's got my vote and, my fellow veterans and fellow citizens, I hope that he has yours."
Mansharamani said that he was honored to have the support of veterans, saying, "It is humbling to have the backing of these veterans and I will make sure that veterans get the care and support they need. Those who have given our country the most should be our priority, not an afterthought. I will always prioritize the needs of our veterans, period."
