subject: Breaking Honest Election News...This is Exciting!
body:
The U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit has ordered an expedited hearing on September 24th in Judicial Watch's lawsuit challenging Mississippi's "extended Election Day" law that permits absentee ballots to be received as late as five business days after Election Day.

t | |
---
|
---
|
---
| Dear Fellow American,

The U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit has ordered an _expedited hearing_ on September 24th in **Judicial Watch's** lawsuit challenging Mississippi's "extended Election Day" law that permits absentee ballots to be received as late as five business days after Election Day.
This "expedited appeal" decision is great news...for honest elections _and_ for Judicial Watch and means that we may be able to see this _reckless law_ stricken from the books prior to Election Day!
**[This is so important that I am asking you to help us with a special contribution today!](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69890&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)**
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69890&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

Your support today will help us when we go to the Appeals Court next month... while keeping up the fight in all our other honest election lawsuits.

Federal election law is very clear...Election Day for federal elections is the first Tuesday after the first Monday in November of every even-numbered year.

But Mississippi passed a law that "extends" Election Day by allowing receipt of absentee ballots for up to five business days after Election Day!

This state law _clearly_ violates federal law...._and it is an open invitation to voter fraud_!

And after what happened in 2020, who wants a repeat of Election Day chaos and confusion?

_Thanks to our members' support_ , Judicial Watch really "delivers the goods" when it comes to honest elections by forcing multiple states to clean their voter rolls...because our lawsuits and settlements have _led to the removal of over 4.5 MILLION ineligible voters_ from voter rolls across the country!

But that's not all....we have also taken "red" Mississippi _and_ "blue" Illinois to court over their efforts to extend Election Day (the Illinois law we're challenging extends Election Day by a mind-boggling 14 days).

Both of these lawsuits are critically important, and almost certainly precedent setting.

**[That's why I am so hopeful you will help us with a special contribution today!](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69890&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)**

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69890&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

| **ICYMI: Tony Wied Welcomes JD Vance to WI-08**
De Pere, WI – Republican nominee Tony Wied (WI-08) welcomed Republican VP nominee JD Vance to AmeriLux International to discuss the economy, inflation, and energy issues with Wisconsin voters.
---
| Wied addressed a packed crowd of supporters prior to JD Vance’s remarks and told the crowd how will help deliver a victory for the GOP ticket in WI-08.
“It is an honor to welcome the next Vice President of the United States to De Pere,” said Wied. “Wisconsin voters are fed up with the failed policies of the Biden-Harris Administration and are ready to send JD Vance and President Trump to the White House.”

body:
The Radical Left has taken over many of our cultural institutions in the last decade.

*|MC_PREVIEW_TEXT|* |
---
| | [](https://email.alerts.therepublicanteam.com/c/eJyUkL2q3DAQRp9G7mS8I9myCxcBs91NES6kNGN5bIurP6TZDXn7sGHzAGnPgQ_O9_Nj_UDnXTy_Y6CZC6-lrinzWllaDFRSlPYqrvIKHWjZjRKmVTX7rA3samhovhnQUw-mV801WzQwqkOrA2iiw2xjb8YRtNUDGE1D4-bXTjfCdOv1pIbWTr3pO2Vv22G23o5Cd-ipcG35okL5sXlnMTJhaG0KjZ8v5lyF-ibgLuBev35zIZJbSl_yQFdqW-j5bG0ScM8o9xSRSaj7g8NqMWR0ZxRqiUnaFLJHF108BQwvH2h3jyDUUuhZLyz05jU9iiWhloxvwlao5fPHJ8h_PW9hU2SKLNTi05maMu_5l_Pe1cEI3Z0Bnf_bwf_x9nOGPwEAAP__WfqK2Q "SkyTree Book Fairs")
Friend,

The Radical Left has taken over many of our cultural institutions in the last decade. Organizations like Scholastic have succumbed to their woke political agenda.

I discovered radical left-wing ideology had infiltrated Scholastic and made their book fairs an unsafe place. They provided books to children that showed explicit images and pushed a woke, radical LGBT political agenda.

That only gives us two options.
1. Complain about the issue and give up.
2. **Take action!**

You know which option I choose. First, I wrote my children’s book, _As You Grow_. **Now, I am helping my friends at SkyTree Book Fairs by promoting their wholesome and age-appropriate book fairs as an alternative to Scholastic. **

SkyTree Book Fairs offers schools, parents, and children a different option. Their book fairs provide empowering literature rooted in truth and family values that foster their imagination and moral character.

Instead of complaining about the Leftists taking over our culture, we need to build our own institutions and take back the content our children are consuming.

https://karenforvirginia.com/ [https://karenforvirginia.com/] Karen Jenkins for HB-89

She is running for the House of Delegates for the 89th District to continue delivering results for the people of Virginia.
She is a champion for education, public safety and mental health. As your next Delegate for the 89th District, she will continue to fight and vote for meaningful policies and legislation to support the needs of the district. body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1851%2E135344%2EIa08-7)

Friend --
Trump will be Michigan today for the second time since Democrats wrapped up their convention last week, and the third time in just 9 days. It would mean A LOT to me if you would chip in today.
**I am asking for a contribution -- $3 or whatever you can afford -- before Donald Trump takes the stage today. If that's all you need to hear, please use this link to donate today:**
**[https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/-Trump-Visit](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240829-2-900&t=2&akid=1851%2E135344%2EIa08-7)**
Here's how former President Trump's visit plays in our race:
We know that both the presidential race and the Senate majority will be decided by Michigan – and recent polls show that our race is a dead heat. Cook Political Report recently downgraded our race from “lean Democratic” to “toss up.”
Given that the Senate race is the top of the ticket in the state, we know that whatever happens in our race will impact the presidential, too. That’s why Trump has given Mike Rogers his full-throated endorsement -- and why he’s attacked me directly, by name, calling me a “far-left liberal lunatic.” We expect to hear that and more today, unfortunately.
He knows that in order to win Michigan, the Republican nominee needs to win the Senate race – and he’s going to do whatever he can to make that happen.
That means we can likely expect to see Trump in Michigan a lot more in the stretch. National Republicans will be doing everything they can to flip our state red and boost our ultimate GOP opponent in the Senate race. In fact, there are already attack ads against me on TV -- and we know more are on the way.
If we are going to keep this seat blue in November, we need to hold the line by keeping our own positive TV ads on the air, doubling down on our field outreach, and continuing to meet voters in every corner of the state.
[**Trump will be here today. It would be a huge boon to our campaign if you would chip in and show your support. Our goal is to send a message that we are NOT letting them win back Michigan! Even a single $5 or $10 contribution goes a long way when lots of folks are chipping in.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240829-2-900&t=3&akid=1851%2E135344%2EIa08-7)

Hello,
In 2022, no one gave my husband Adam Frisch a chance against Lauren Boebert.
Everywhere you looked, the political pundits were calling Colorado’s 3rd congressional district “Safe Republican” or “Solid R.”
Nate Silver’s FiveThirtyEight only gave Adam a 3% chance of defeating Boebert. They projected he’d lose by over 45,000 votes!
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91757608/494888824/1610638071?refcode=em20240829mid-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=278e91cb-1f66-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNzhlOTFjYi0xZjY2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ThXv5Wsfds-G3c9J14GwV9ypgduT5TxKJITzpyvgj-0=)
In the end, though, the race went to a recount. **Lauren Boebert won by just 546 votes, and Adam lost the closest race in the entire country.**
Because here’s what their “models” and “forecasts” didn’t factor in: Adam put in the work. He traveled 24,000 miles in our red pickup truck to every corner of the district. He met thousands and thousands of voters – and he _listened_.
Now, Lauren Boebert's run off scared, and I’ll be honest: The first campaign was hard. But winning this House seat is now going to be even harder. **Adam’s all-in to finish the job in 2024. I’m all-in. Can we count on you?**

He met thousands and thousands of voters – and he listened. Now, Lauren Boebert's run off scared, and I’ll be honest: The first campaign was hard. But winning this House seat is now going to be even harder. Adam’s all-in to finish the job in 2024. I’m all-in. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91759260/494893429/-849459103?refcode=ea.0346997a-2166-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.0346997a-2166-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMzQ2OTk3YS0yMTY2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vG9cJLG3VEs6KNuicxLljxK34_nnRXtUKkfwkxnpmu8=&emci=fad7d35a-6665-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&emdi=0346997a-2166-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ceid=46764483)
---
| There’s a reason why Democrats are inspiring hope and change across the country, and it’s on full display this election season ⬇️
---
**At the GOP Convention:** Attendees waved signs calling to deport immigrants. **At the DNC:** We chanted “USA! USA!” while we celebrated our nation’s diversity and strength.
---
**Republicans** want to tell you when and how you can have a baby. **Democrats** want to stay out of your bedroom and your doctor’s office.
---
**The GOP** chooses to ignore the gun violence epidemic that is tearing our communities apart. **Democrats** are fighting tooth and nail for common-sense gun safety laws.
---
**Marsha Blackburn** rakes in millions from Big Oil, the NRA, and the pharmaceutical industry, and does their bidding in Washington. As for **me**? I’m funded by you — hardworking people and families who deserve real representation.

Hey friend,
I’m fighting for a more free and prosperous nation for every American, but I’m counting on Democrats in Nevada and across the nation to join me in this fight for our future.
We need to hold the White House and the Senate if we want to deliver progress on the issues that matter most:
* Passing federal protections for abortion rights, birth control, and IVF
* Expanding access to quality, affordable health care
* Lowering costs for middle class families
* Taking action to reduce gun violence
* Demanding ethics and transparency for Supreme Court justices

There will be a stark choice for voters in this election between MAGA extremism and common sense leadership. If Republicans retake control of Washington, they will use their power to attack our democracy, roll back abortion rights even further, and hand out more tax breaks to billionaires and giant corporations. **_We will not go back._**
Nevada will likely determine control of the Senate this year. Losing any ground gives the GOP a clear path to flipping the Senate red – and puts MAGA extremists like my opponent, Sam Brown, one step closer to pushing through a horrifying far-right agenda known as Project 2025. **Dark money groups and Super PACs like the Koch network are pouring MILLIONS into Nevada to defeat me.**
But you and I know that when we join together and fight back, we win.

body:

Please read the following message
from our sponsor.

What is the first thing you do in
the morning?

Do you stretch? Drink water? Or
go to the bathroom?

It may be a weird
question…

But new groundbreaking research

morning habit.

88,268 people - who had suffered

do…

subject: Avoid these 5 common hydration mistakes…
body:
But the truth is, too much water is NOT the cause of your bathroom struggles...

Hey Friend... it’s me—your bladder!

I’m trying to help you out here.

I’ve noticed less water coming through lately... and you might think that will make those occasional leaks and urges better...

But the truth is, too much water is NOT the cause of your bathroom struggles...

In fact, it’s the opposite.

Once you hit 50, a few things got out of whack.

**Kidneys stopped filtering fluid as well as they once did** \- causing concentrated urine that irritates your bladder and causes spontaneous urges.

**Thirst signals slow down, causing you to drink less** \- making bladder muscles lazy and causing occasional leaks.

Luckily, US Army researchers decoded a shockingly easy water trick with two ingredients that can improve muscle strength by 36%, improve bladder health by 58%, and give you control back...

All by targeting _the true cause_ of bladder problems**.**

name: Colin Allred
subject: about my DNC speech
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
Derek, I got to speak at the Democratic National Convention last week, and I have to tell you: the energy that Democrats have right now – the energy that was in this completely packed building – is unlike anything I’ve ever felt before.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240829?refcode=em20240829-9331&refcode2=9331_434096_VWhq1d&akid=9331%2E434096%2EVWhq1d)
Everywhere I look, I'm seeing people who are hopeful and excited about this election – and it's not just what I felt last week. I've been feeling it in Dallas and San Antonio and all across Texas, too.
That's how I know we're going to win this race. I've been saying since day one of this campaign that we're going to defeat Ted Cruz and protect our Senate majority – now, I need people like you behind me to get us across the finish line.
**[If you’re ready to kick Ted Cruz out of the Senate and protect our Democratic Senate majority, will you rush a split donation of $25 or more between me and John Fetterman to help my campaign keep building on this momentum so we can win on Nov. 5?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240829?refcode=em20240829-9331&refcode2=9331_434096_VWhq1d&akid=9331%2E434096%2EVWhq1d)**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240829?amount=5&refcode=em20240829-9331&refcode2=9331_434096_VWhq1d&akid=9331%2E434096%2EVWhq1d)**
I’m honored to be the Democratic nominee for the U.S. Senate from Texas. I’m a fourth-generation Texan, and everything I’ve done in my life – from making it to the NFL, to law school, and finally to Congress – is thanks to opportunities that Texas has given me. In my Texas, we believe that WE is more powerful than ME.
But Ted Cruz doesn’t believe in the Texas that I know and love. He doesn’t believe you should help your neighbors when things get tough. He doesn’t believe that our seniors deserve the Social Security and Medicare they have earned. He doesn’t believe that women should be able to make their own health care decisions.
**All Ted Cruz cares about is himself – and Texas deserves much better than a me-guy who runs to Cancun when we’re in crisis.**
**Right now, we’re building the largest grassroots team Texas has ever seen to defeat Ted Cruz and flip Texas blue. But he’s got an army of right-wing donors and far-right super PACs behind him, and I can’t win this race without your support.**
**[So please, if you're ready to defeat Ted Cruz, bring real leadership to Texas, and defend our narrow Senate majority, will you rush a split donation of $25 or whatever you can afford between me and John Fetterman right now?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240829?refcode=em20240829-9331&refcode2=9331_434096_VWhq1d&akid=9331%2E434096%2EVWhq1d)**

Let's win this.
– Colin Allred

subject: last-ditch request...
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Democratic National Committee, www
body:
This is why we keep circling back to you.
---
Derek, We have reached out a number of times asking you to donate to help Kamala Harris and Democrats win this November, but just haven't been able to break through. We've sent messages from Kamala Harris and Tim Walz. We've explained how we'd invest your contribution to help Democrats win. If you cannot afford a $3 contribution today, we totally understand. Please just archive this email and know that your vote is what we need most. But if you can afford that $3 contribution, let us make one last-ditch request today: The Democratic National Convention just wrapped up. Our FEC deadline ends in a few days. Trump and the RNC are hammering Democrats with ads in key states. And we cannot reach our fundraising goals without many more people making their first donation of the election cycle before early voting begins. That's why we keep circling back to you, Derek. If everyone getting this email donated $3 to the DNC today, we'd crush our budget goals today alone and have all the resources we need before early voting begins. You know which option I choose. First, I wrote my children’s book, As You Grow. Now, I am helping my friends at SkyTree Book Fairs by promoting their wholesome and age-appropriate book fairs as an alternative to Scholastic. SkyTree Book Fairs offers schools, parents, and children a different option. Their book fairs provide empowering literature rooted in truth and family values that foster their imagination and moral character. Instead of complaining about the Leftists taking over our culture, we need to build our own institutions and take back the content our children are consuming. Here’s how you can help. The best part about SkyTree Book Fairs is that parents don’t have to worry about the content found in their books. SkyTree Book Fairs believes that book fairs should not contain hidden, explicit content targeted at children. They pre-screen every title so you can rest knowing that your child will only be exposed to age-appropriate books that let kids be kids. Today’s children should get to experience the family-friendly book fairs that we had growing up. This is our opportunity to make it happen. You can help SkyTree Book Fairs build up a strong and healthy generation inspired by wholesome reading. Please click below to support a wholesome book fair today! Even though Scholastic holds a virtual monopoly on school book fairs, the demand for an alternative is clear! Dear
Friend,

In the
annals of history, military triumphs and defeats have been
attributed to a host of factors-material resources, manpower,
pre-war strategies, and tactical doctrine all play a part in
determining the victors and the vanquished.

However,
as we delve deeper into the past, we uncover a truth that
surpasses conventional wisdom-a truth of extraordinary
significance.

Throughout pivotal moments in history, we have witnessed the
remarkable transformation of seemingly lost causes, orchestrated
by the savior generals-visionary leaders displaying unparalleled
expertise.

Today,
I'm pleased to share with you a free resource that will ignite
your curiosity and challenge your perceptions. Esteemed historian
and Hoover Senior Fellow, Victor Davis Hanson, has authored a
groundbreaking eBook-Victory and the Savior Generals-a
captivating exploration into the minds of these exceptional
leaders.

You can
secure your free copy today by clicking on this exclusive link:
https://resources.hoover.org/victory-and-the-savior-generals

Inside
its digital pages, you'll embark on a journey that uncovers the
defining traits of these savior generals. Their ingenuity,
contrarian spirit, and unwavering courage breathed new life into
seemingly lost causes. Their profound understanding of conflict,
rejection of complacency, adaptability to change, and alignment
with societal values contributed to their monumental successes.

This is
your opportunity to unravel the secrets of history's most
influential leaders, unlocking invaluable lessons that resonate
even in the present day.

Claim
your complimentary copy of Victory and the Savior Generals now
through this secure link:
https://resources.hoover.org/victory-and-the-savior-generals

Wishing
you a wonderful journey through the pages of history!

Greg

** NHGOP United in Victory Breakfast
------------------------------------------------------------

** Thursday, September 12
------------------------------------------------------------

** Doors Open 8am
------------------------------------------------------------

The primary season will soon be behind us, and it will be the time to quickly come together as one strong, united Republican team!

We are excited to invite you to the NHGOP Unity Breakfast on September 12th, where we will rally together and prepare for the critical challenges ahead on the path to November.

Event Details:

Date: Thursday, September 12, 2024
Time: Doors open 8am. Breakfast & Program 8:30am to 10:00am.
Location: Grappone Conference Center, 70 Constitution Ave Concord NH

This is our opportunity to put any differences behind us and focus on our shared goal: victory in November to keep our state SANE.

Whether you're a candidate, supporter, or volunteer, your presence is vital as we launch the final phase of our campaign. Let's show New Hampshire that the GOP is stronger and more united than ever.

Please RSVP by September 1 to ensure we have a spot for you at this important gathering.

Thank you for your commitment to our shared Republican values. Together, we will win!

Looking forward to seeing you there,

Chris Ager
Chairman, NHGOP

P.S. Let’s show the strength of a united GOP. We need everyone on board to ensure a successful November!

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91765434/494911084/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDRmODI0YmYtMjk2Ni1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=nEZ7kBIoBTw5wOg0Jal1ZCZEj9GO3FLTLF1njuiYOc4=&emci=8380fcb6-2366-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&emdi=44f824bf-2966-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
At two different rallies this month, JD Vance has introduced Trump with a new line: _**“they tried to kill him.”**_
The speech harkens back to the assassination attempt Trump survived when a disturbed young man shot several people at a Pennsylvania rally in a tragic moment of gun violence that’s become all too common in America.
**Yesterday, the FBI concluded there was no motive for the shooting, so who exactly is the “they” JD Vance is referring to?**
[**We’ll explain how Vance and Republicans use the word “they” to spread dangerous lies about Democrats in a moment, but if you support COURIER’s mission to take on the divisive conspiracy theories spread by the right, can you chip in $25 now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91765436/494911086/-593472309?refcode=20240829-EM-JDVanceStump&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDRmODI0YmYtMjk2Ni1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=nEZ7kBIoBTw5wOg0Jal1ZCZEj9GO3FLTLF1njuiYOc4=)
To understand more about how Vance and MAGA Republicans use the word “they” to soft-sell dangerous conspiracy theories about Democrats to their base, take a look at this speech excerpt from Vance when introducing Trump in North Carolina last week:
_**“They couldn't beat him at the ballot box, so they tried to bankrupt him. They failed at that, so they tried to impeach him. They failed at that. So they tried to put him in prison, and they even tried to kill him."**_
While only three sentences long, Vance’s speech excerpt is filled with dangerous lies and innuendo about the Democratic party and Trump’s political opponents.
Trump lost the 2020 election because more voters voted for Biden, and Biden won the Electoral College. No one tried to bankrupt Trump – the State of New York leveled a $450 million fine against his business after it was found guilty of fraud.
**And Democrats didn’t try to kill Trump – a lone gunman tragically did. The assassination attempt was a dark day in our country, and in the days following the shooting, Democrats everywhere expressed gratitude and relief that Trump was okay. **
**Vance suggesting otherwise is dangerous and irresponsible, especially in a moment where our political divisions are so volatile and deep. **
Of course, we know that division is by design. For a decade, Trump and his MAGA allies have used innuendo and conspiracies against Democrats to keep a large portion of their base paranoid, fearful, and cultishly loyal to Trump.
We’ve already seen the tragic consequences of this kind of rhetoric. In the months following the 2020 election, Republicans spread the lie that Biden and Democrats stole the vote – that lie led to the attacks on the Capitol on January 6.
Trump is desperate for power, Peter, and he’ll do just about anything to get it, even if it means destroying this country.
**That’s why COURIER is so needed right now. **
We work around the clock to call out and counter dangerous right-wing misinformation like this. Not only that, but we are actively working to change the conversation by providing free, factual news online about the issues that matter in the communities we serve.
**[We have less than 70 days left until election day, and this dangerous rhetoric will only increase. clean_body: The VP pick’s vague use of “they” points toward a sinister conspiracy Peter, At two different rallies this month, JD Vance has introduced Trump with a new line: “they tried to kill him.” The speech harkens back to the assassination attempt Trump survived when a disturbed young man shot several people at a Pennsylvania rally in a tragic moment of gun violence that’s become all too common in America. Yesterday, the FBI concluded there was no motive for the shooting, so who exactly is the “they” JD Vance is referring to? = To understand more about how Vance and MAGA Republicans use the word “they” to soft-sell dangerous conspiracy theories about Democrats to their base, take a look at this speech excerpt from Vance when introducing Trump in North Carolina last week: “They couldn't beat him at the ballot box, so they tried to bankrupt him. They failed at that, so they tried to impeach him. They failed at that. So they tried to put him in prison, and they even tried to kill him." While only three sentences long, Vance’s speech excerpt is filled with dangerous lies and innuendo about the Democratic party and Trump’s political opponents. Trump lost the 2020 election because more voters voted for Biden, and Biden won the Electoral College. No one tried to bankrupt Trump – the State of New York leveled a $450 million fine against his business after it was found guilty of fraud. And Democrats didn’t try to kill Trump – a lone gunman tragically did. The assassination attempt was a dark day in our country, and in the days following the shooting, Democrats everywhere expressed gratitude and relief that Trump was okay. Vance suggesting otherwise is dangerous and irresponsible, especially in a moment where our political divisions are so volatile and deep. Of course, we know that division is by design. For a decade, Trump and his MAGA allies have used innuendo and conspiracies against Democrats to keep a large portion of their base paranoid, fearful, and cultishly loyal to Trump. We’ve already seen the tragic consequences of this kind of rhetoric. In the months following the 2020 election, Republicans spread the lie that Biden and Democrats stole the vote – that lie led to the attacks on the Capitol on January 6. Trump is desperate for power, Peter, and he’ll do just about anything to get it, even if it means destroying this country. That’s why COURIER is so needed right now. We work around the clock to call out and counter dangerous right-wing misinformation like this. name: Major General Paul Eaton, U.S. Army, Ret.
subject: Absolutely disgusting
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTEVETS, VOTEVETS
body:
Every year, my wife and I go to Arlington National Cemetery to pay our respects to the fallen. Some killed in action, some died of wounds, injuries, or illnesses related to service, some of natural causes at home. All served with honor.
#
Paul Eaton here, wanted to send a personal note about something that has left me shocked, disturbed, and absolutely disgusted.
Every year, my wife and I go to Arlington National Cemetery to pay our respects to the fallen. Some killed in action, some died of wounds, injuries, or illnesses related to service, some of natural causes at home. All served with honor.
Among them are my father and his co-pilot, shot down over Laos during the Vietnam War. They were missing in action for thirty years, but now they are at peace together in that solemn and dignified place where the very best of our nation rest.
I’ve stood with my dear friend, Karen Meredith, at the grave of her son, 1LT Ken Ballard, in Section 60 where the fallen from the Global War on Terror are buried.
These are powerful experiences for me, and they should be for everyone who goes to this hallowed ground.
To hear that Donald Trump descreated this place, that he took photographs and video among the graves of the fallen without their families' permission... That he mugged for the camera for political gain is absolutely disgusting to me. That an Arlington official attempting to enforce the law and defend the dignity of Arlington was assaulted, verbally and physically, by Trump’s staff so they could access Section 60... I cannot even begin to comprehend it.
I want to be absolutely clear: This is something I have never seen or heard of in my entire life. To my knowledge, something like this has never occurred. And someone who can do something like that has no place leading the men and women of our Armed Forces.
Donald Trump cannot become Commander in Chief again.
It is on us to make sure that does not happen. That is why I am proud to work with VoteVets, and it is why I am asking you to make a donation to support our work right now.
[**Please, if you can make a donation of anything at all, we will use it to ensure that the American people never forget that Donald Trump desecrated one of our most sacred places. # The Election is Less Than 10 Weeks Away!
---
| Believe it or not, the November 5 General Election is in less than 10 weeks! And in just over seven weeks, ballots will be mailed out.
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
| | Dr Garcia is on the campaign trail in full force, reaching out to voters with his message of bringing new leadership to Washington so we can get our great state back on track.
Last week Raul had the pleasure of catching up with Dino Rossi, former state senator and candidate for Governor & U.S. Senator. Dino more than most understands how crucial elections are:
First, we need to elect new leaders in order to change the direction of our state. And second, we need everyone to vote, get involved and give financial support in order to win a statewide election!
---
|
---
|
# Your Support Will Help Us Win!
---
| So many of you have been so generous with your financial support. We are very grateful to have you on our team!
[**If you haven’t made a contribution yet, or if you’re able to give more, please consider donating.**](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=7c0591bd56&e=3ed3552a03) Every dollar you give helps us reach more Washington voters, especially in the Puget Sound region which is essential to statewide victory.
[**By donating $5, $10, $25, $50 or $100 — or whatever you can give — you make it possible to elect Dr Garcia and defeat Sen. Cantwell in November.**](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=f00cba8a3b&e=3ed3552a03)

The history of the Roman Republic is a captivating tale of achievement, political and military genius, and the perils of success. One that still impacts our world today.

To help tell this important story to Americans nationwide, we released our free online course, **" The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic."**

**You can now receive your own DVD box set of "The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic" when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**

That's why we produced **" The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic"** and why I hope you'll watch and share the course on DVD.

Thank you for helping to preserve liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!

Best regards,

Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D.

Hillsdale College

One of the most frustrating things about the people demanding we stop calls for ceasefire and an arms embargo because it's "hurting Harris's chances to win" is that the exact opposite is true. Polling repeatedly shows that ending arms to Netanyahu _**expands**_ the voter base and _**increases**_ Harris's chances to win in November. **Let 's Address This.**
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2550223&post_id=148271617&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ4MjcxNjE3LCJpYXQiOjE3MjQ5NTM4MjMsImV4cCI6MTcyNzU0NTgyMywiaXNzIjoicHViLTI1NTAyMjMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.c6UaIX8aiUucCxTxZmPDOqg7ZZq24EfcwDQ-vcTXl0M)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a8def89d-3cd0-423d-973a-2682b18d9dab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Protesters outside the White House denounce U.S. arm shipments to Israel during a May 2, 2024 demonstration in Washington, D.C.
(Photo: Amnesty International USA)
## Polling is clear -- stop arming Netanyahu
Much of successful politics is about risk avoidance. And polling has repeatedly shown that notwithstanding the moral and legal indefensibility of continuing to arm Netanyahu, arming Netanyahu is also a politically indefensible maneuver. Way back in March, a poll conducted by the [Center for Economic Policy and Research](https://substack.com/redirect/926e618c-ef5a-4672-b8a8-35c7b1a3c5a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) found that 52% of Americans, including 62% of Democrats, want Biden to end offensive arms to Netanyahu. And as Netanyahu's siege on Gaza has raged on, the number of Americans who agree that we must stop arming this genocide has dramatically increased.
More recently, a [YouGov/IMEU Policy Project poll](https://substack.com/redirect/8e52cc75-9d51-4793-92d8-6a7adebddf4c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) among Democrats and Independents in the swing states of Arizona, Georgia, and Pennsylvania, finds that the Harris/Walz path to victory includes announcing a cessation of arms to Netanyahu.
In Arizona:
* 35% of voters said they would be _more_ likely to vote for the Harris if she vowed to stop weapons to Israel. Only 5% said they are less likely to vote for that policy.
* This is a strong 7:1 ratio of voter support in a state Biden won by only 11,000 votes in 2020.

In Georgia:
* 39% of voters said they are more likely to vote for Harris if she commits to end weapons to Israel. Again, only 5% said they are less likely to vote for that policy.
* Again, an encouraging 8:1 ratio of voter support in a state that Biden barely won by 12,000 votes in 2020.

In Pennsylvania:
* 34% of voters in Pennsylvania say they are more likely to vote for Harris if she vows to withhold weapons to Israel. Only 7% said they would be less likely to vote for Harris for that policy change.
* This is still a strong 5:1 ratio of voter support in a state Biden won by only 82,000 votes in 2020.

[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..HPUEe3nQy1SMMbK19Icqjmwz-ng9MnkidpVo3AlecSQ?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=148271617)
## National polls agree with swing state polls
And these are not just swing state trends. Yet another poll, this time a national CBS/YouGov poll, reports [the following critical facts](https://substack.com/redirect/34d12f4b-cd2a-479a-a0b1-f0d3781eeeb1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) about how united Americans are to end the siege on Gaza by withholding arms from Netanyahu:
* 61% of Americans oppose weapons to Israel's assault in Gaza
* 77% of Democrats reject US weapons to Israel
* 63% of moderates reject US weapons to Israel
* 77% of voters under 30 oppose weapons to Israel
* 75% of Black Americans oppose weapons to Israel
* 66% of women oppose weapons to Israel
* 56% of white college grads oppose weapons to Israel

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/35ad4700-c59c-4cfd-9603-8cc538033fad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Imagine any other issue with such overwhelming support--yet both candidates running for office decide to push a policy to the exact contrary? It makes little sense. And yes, as Vice President, Harris does not have the authority to unilaterally end arms to Netanyahu just yet. But that's true of most any policy too. For example, Harris also does not have unilateral authority to pass legislation to protect reproductive rights. However, I am grateful that she's been unapologetic about pushing for legislation to protect reproductive rights when elected President. She's doing so because it is the moral, legal, and politically right thing to do. Harris can employ the same future vision about ending arms to Netanyahu. Doing so would demonstrate to the American people that she hears them and is responsive to them.
## It's wise to move on from Biden's policy on Israel
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dc1dc03f-2fe5-4122-bb6a-a1d6fa7cb4a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I have said this repeatedly--rejecting Biden's policy of total allegiance to Netanyahu is not extreme--it is popular and right. Doing so will better solidify a Democrat win on November 5, and Harris and Walz should act immediately. Ending this genocide by stopping arms to Netanyahu is the moral, legal, _and_ politically right thing to do. It is morally correct because genocide is by definition immoral. It is legally correct because it will uphold the Leahy Laws and international human rights law. And it is politically correct because an overwhelming number of Americans demand it.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ad4c47e0-1624-4453-83b4-d9dc9de39c38?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
It is indefensible that while the global and American majority wants to end arms to Netanyahu, [war profiteer corporations are predicting a doubled increase in cash flow due to war expansion](https://substack.com/redirect/42ad9364-a54b-4658-a0ac-fafad50bc278?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). It should come as no surprise that more than [250 major global humanitarian organizations](https://substack.com/redirect/f1987b14-eace-4a68-8d48-f824d837f6e5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) have called on the US Government to stop arming Netanyahu. Or that seven major American labor unions including [the UAW want the US Government to stop arming Netanyahu](https://substack.com/redirect/8c06602f-b355-479a-8e9f-98c1f2b6221f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Or that major civil rights organizations like the [NAACP want the US Government to stop arming Netanyahu](https://substack.com/redirect/60559c00-1c9f-46da-b790-bea76f44c1d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). This is the right thing to do, and Harris should lead the charge for this cause of justice.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e0c53f05-1daa-4477-accf-718064306c0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Without question, Donald Trump is an existential threat to American democracy. This only further obliges us to adopt every good and just policy that ensures he loses in November. Stopping arms to prevent Netanyahu from committing genocide in Gaza is one such good and just and popular policy. To increase Harris's chances to win in November, we must stand with the majority of Americans and push forward these critical initiatives today. We cannot continue to jeopardize American democracy for Netanyahu's war crimes. We must instead protect American democracy and end offensive arms to Netanyahu.

One of the most frustrating things about the people demanding we stop calls for ceasefire and an arms embargo because it's "hurting Harris's chances to win" is that the exact opposite is true. Polling repeatedly shows that ending arms to Netanyahu expands the voter base and increases Harris's chances to win in November. Let 's Address This. | | ---|---|--- Protesters outside the White House denounce U.S. arm shipments to Israel during a May 2, 2024 demonstration in Washington, D.C. (Photo: Amnesty International USA) Polling is clear -- stop arming Netanyahu Much of successful politics is about risk avoidance. And polling has repeatedly shown that notwithstanding the moral and legal indefensibility of continuing to arm Netanyahu, arming Netanyahu is also a politically indefensible maneuver. Way back in March, a poll conducted by the found that 52% of Americans, including 62% of Democrats, want Biden to end offensive arms to Netanyahu. And as Netanyahu's siege on Gaza has raged on, the number of Americans who agree that we must stop arming this genocide has dramatically increased. More recently, a among Democrats and Independents in the swing states of Arizona, Georgia, and Pennsylvania, finds that the Harris/Walz path to victory includes announcing a cessation of arms to Netanyahu. In Arizona: 35% of voters said they would be more likely to vote for the Harris if she vowed to stop weapons to Israel. Only 5% said they are less likely to vote for that policy. This is a strong 7:1 ratio of voter support in a state Biden won by only 11,000 votes in 2020. In Georgia: 39% of voters said they are more likely to vote for Harris if she commits to end weapons to Israel. Again, only 5% said they are less likely to vote for that policy. Again, an encouraging 8:1 ratio of voter support in a state that Biden barely won by 12,000 votes in 2020. In Pennsylvania: 34% of voters in Pennsylvania say they are more likely to vote for Harris if she vows to withhold weapons to Israel. Only 7% said they would be less likely to vote for Harris for that policy change. This is still a strong 5:1 ratio of voter support in a state Biden won by only 82,000 votes in 2020. National polls agree with swing state polls And these are not just swing state trends. Yet another poll, this time a national CBS/YouGov poll, reports about how united Americans are to end the siege on Gaza by withholding arms from Netanyahu: 61% of Americans oppose weapons to Israel's assault in Gaza 77% of Democrats reject US weapons to Israel 63% of moderates reject US weapons to Israel 77% of voters under 30 oppose weapons to Israel 75% of Black Americans oppose weapons to Israel 66% of women oppose weapons to Israel 56% of white college grads oppose weapons to Israel | | ---|---|--- Imagine any other issue with such overwhelming support--yet both candidates running for office decide to push a policy to the exact contrary? It makes little sense. And yes, as Vice President, Harris does not have the authority to unilaterally end arms to Netanyahu just yet. But that's true of most any policy too. For example, Harris also does not have unilateral authority to pass legislation to protect reproductive rights. However, I am grateful that she's been unapologetic about pushing for legislation to protect reproductive rights when elected President. She's doing so because it is the moral, legal, and politically right thing to do. Harris can employ the same future vision about ending arms to Netanyahu. Doing so would demonstrate to the American people that she hears them and is responsive to them. It's wise to move on from Biden's policy on Israel | | ---|---|--- I have said this repeatedly--rejecting Biden's policy of total allegiance to Netanyahu is not extreme--it is popular and right. Doing so will better solidify a Democrat win on November 5, and Harris and Walz should act immediately. Ending this genocide by stopping arms to Netanyahu is the moral, legal, and politically right thing to do. It is morally correct because genocide is by definition immoral. It is legally correct because it will uphold the Leahy Laws and international human rights law. And it is politically correct because an overwhelming number of Americans demand it. | | ---|---|--- It is indefensible that while the global and American majority wants to end arms to Netanyahu, . It should come as no surprise that more than have called on the US Government to stop arming Netanyahu. Or that seven major American labor unions including . Or that major civil rights organizations like the . This is the right thing to do, and Harris should lead the charge for this cause of justice. | | ---|---|--- Without question, Donald Trump is an existential threat to American democracy. This only further obliges us to adopt every good and just policy that ensures he loses in November. Stopping arms to prevent Netanyahu from committing genocide in Gaza is one such good and just and popular policy. To increase Harris's chances to win in November, we must stand with the majority of Americans and push forward these critical initiatives today. We cannot continue to jeopardize American democracy for Netanyahu's war crimes. We must instead protect American democracy and end offensive arms to Netanyahu. Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=082924_2&amount=25]
DD: Disenfranchising Rural North Carolina Is By Design [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=082924_2&amount=25]
One of the sneakiest things about North Carolina's 2023 voter suppression bill, S.B. 747, is how it disenfranchises rural communities across our state.
The North Carolina state legislature, along party lines, passed a sweeping package of changes to state election laws ahead of the 2024 elections — including throwing out any mail-in ballots not received by Election Night , instead of the current three-day grace period after the election.
The biggest issue for rural activists is the change to the rules for same-day voter registration. S.B. 747 makes it so that many people could go to the polls, lawfully vote, and later learn — or perhaps never learn — that their vote didn’t count. This is because the new law mandates that their ballot will be thrown out if a single piece of mail sent to them after they vote by their county board of elections is returned as undeliverable. Their voter registration would be thrown out, too. And we all know how rural mail service can be unreliable.
Intricate rules like this (or states like Pennsylvania that require the voter to write the date they completed their ballot in multiple, obscure places) are not written because lawmakers don't understand how people vote. Laws like this are written specifically so that opponents of voting rights have legal avenues to throw out your ballot and invalidate your vote . The working poor and struggling middle class are most likely to get caught in this trap, not the wealthy donors who back the vote suppressors.
All voters deserve to have their voices heard in our elections, Team, not to have their ballots tossed out on technicalities. Help fight these suppressive and disenfranchising laws with $25 or whatever you can today and protect voting rights across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=082924_2&amount=25]

Dear Peter,
I hope you had a chance to read the email my dad sent you. To say that it meant the world to me would be an understatement. My dad is my hero, and seeing him speak from the heart about our journey together brought a tear to my eye. He’s been there for me through every challenge and triumph, and his belief in me is a big part of what keeps me going.
I want to take a moment to share a bit more about my journey with you —how I got here, and why this campaign matters so much to me.
I have less than 48 hours to report strong fundraising numbers before this end-of-month deadline - so please read the rest of my message to you Peter, and if you're able, donate using this link or the ones below! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/082924mh4c]
Growing up in Stilwell, Oklahoma, life wasn’t always easy. Our hometown has the lowest life expectancy in the state , and I saw firsthand the struggles that come with that. From a young age, I learned the importance of hard work by working alongside my dad on our farm. He taught me that no matter how tough things get, you keep pushing forward. It’s a lesson that has shaped who I am today. https://secure.actblue.com/donate/082924mh4c [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/082924mh4c]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/082924mh4c [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/082924mh4c] When I decided to pursue a career in cybersecurity, it wasn’t the typical path for someone from a small town like ours. But I’ve never been one to shy away from challenges . I’ve spent my career defending our nation against threats, and now I’m running for Congress because I believe we need that same resilience and determination to protect our communities and ensure that every Oklahoman has a shot at a better future.
This campaign isn’t just about me—it’s about all of us. It’s about making sure that communities like ours aren’t left behind, that the people who feel forgotten have a voice.
My dad’s words reminded me of why I’m in this fight: because I believe in the power of people to create change, and I believe in the future we can build together.
But to make that future a reality, I need your help. We’re nearing the end of the month, and we still have a significant fundraising gap to close. Every dollar you contribute brings us one step closer to winning this race and making the changes that Oklahoma so desperately needs.
So, I’m asking—will you stand with me today? Your support means more to me than I can express, and it’s what will carry us through to victory in November.

In the wake of 9/11 at 17 years old, I had a deep sense of duty to serve the country, but policies like “Don’t Ask, Don’t Tell” discouraged me from joining the military. Things have changed a lot for the better since then, but despite all the progress that’s been made, we’re seeing a rise in anti-LGBTQ+ sentiment -- from book bans, anti-trans legislation, and boycotts against businesses that prioritize equality. This has all been perpetuated by folks like my opponent Ken Calvert, and the entire MAGA caucus. We can send a clear message that rejects the GOP’s hateful agenda by turning the House blue this November. That starts by flipping CA-41. Like many, my partner Paolo and I came of age at a time when being gay was still considered a crime in many states. In the wake of 9/11 at 17 years old, I had a deep sense of duty to serve the country, but policies like “Don’t Ask, Don’t Tell” discouraged me from joining the military. Things have changed a lot for the better since then, but despite all the progress that’s been made, we’re seeing a rise in anti-LGBTQ+ sentiment -- from book bans, anti-trans legislation, and boycotts against businesses that prioritize equality. This has all been perpetuated by folks like my opponent Ken Calvert, and the entire MAGA caucus. We can send a clear message that rejects the GOP’s hateful agenda by turning the House blue this November. That starts by flipping CA-41. subject: Now is a *critical* time for public education
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pereles for Missouri, Rhonda West, Treasurer
body:
https://www.perelesformissouri.com/ [https://www.perelesformissouri.com/]
Peter,
Last week, children across Missouri returned to classes. And while education may be top of mind for so many right now, we need to make sure that voters keep in mind what is at stake for public education in our state ahead of the election this November.
Public education is critical to the future success of our state. Safeguarding public education and improving educational outcomes for all children is a top priority for me. As State Senator, I will work tirelessly to make quality education a reality for all of Missouri’s children.
Teachers, educators, librarians, everyone who works hard to teach, educate, and inspire our children every single day—they deserve much more than they get.
That’s why I wholeheartedly support better pay for our teachers and a return to a traditional 5-day school week for all public schools. We can also better support our teachers and students by reducing class sizes and fully funding K-12 education, every single year.
And at a time when educators have been caught in the crossfire of petty right wing culture wars and radical attempts to defund and undermine universal, quality public education, I am proud to stand with Missouri teachers and educators.

Securing a brighter future for our children demands that we elect leaders who will support educators and ensure the best possible education for Missouri’s children.
I am in this race to do what is right and what is best for the people of Missouri and Senate District 15.
I know that we will win if we work together to keep raising the resources we need to get our message to every voter in this district—but I need your help to do this as we enter the final stretch of the campaign. -Joe

**
My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

name: Emily Randall
subject: I don’t know how much grace I have in my heart for Marjorie Taylor Greene.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Emily Randall for Congress
body:
In the next 68 days, we need to reach out to everyone we know — Democrats, independents, and Republicans alike — to make sure they understand what’s at stake in this election.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91773185/494937024/2145945666?refcode=RS_EM_FR_2024.08.29_MTG2_Actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNDZjZWIyYy0zNDY2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CPqTdCFnXk2nF_1iOgg19SiKemK_9voKoUG291kZ050=&emci=1b50fa65-3366-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&emdi=046ceb2c-3466-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ceid=23483442) | I was thrilled to speak to [__**The Advocate**__](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91773186/494937025/-1528054214?refcode=RS_EM_FR_2024.08.29_MTG2_Actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNDZjZWIyYy0zNDY2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CPqTdCFnXk2nF_1iOgg19SiKemK_9voKoUG291kZ050=&emci=1b50fa65-3366-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&emdi=046ceb2c-3466-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ceid=23483442) about my campaign and making history in Washington’s 6th District! Near the end of the interview, they asked what I thought of going to Congress to work with Republicans like Marjorie Taylor Greene, who are vocally opposed to equal rights for LGBTQ+ people. Here’s what I said: **I don’t know how much grace I have in my heart for Marjorie Taylor Greene.** But, I have a lot of grace in my heart for the Republicans that remind me of my dad, who are interested in having conversations and talking through how they got to their position and listening to how I got to mine. My approach is often showing up and listening, asking ‘what do you mean?’ questions. Sometimes, that doesn’t work, but those conversations matter so much. **Peter: In the next 68 days, we need to reach out to everyone we know — Democrats, independents, and Republicans alike — to make sure they understand what’s at stake in this election. ** With your help, our campaign will be able to spread our positive, pro-choice message to every single person in this District so we can win this race and take back the House. _[**We have to raise another $10,000 before the end of August to stay on track. Please make a contribution of $6 or any amount to fuel our inclusive, community-centered campaign →**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91773187/494937026/1951025404?amount=10&refcode=RS_EM_FR_2024.08.29_MTG2_Actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNDZjZWIyYy0zNDY2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CPqTdCFnXk2nF_1iOgg19SiKemK_9voKoUG291kZ050=)_ [CONTRIBUTE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91773188/494937027/1951025404?amount=10&refcode=RS_EM_FR_2024.08.29_MTG2_Actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNDZjZWIyYy0zNDY2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CPqTdCFnXk2nF_1iOgg19SiKemK_9voKoUG291kZ050=) Thank you 💙 — Emily

# FROM THE DESK OF LARRY KUDLOW
---
| | Reader,**I am pleased to share with you that The New York Sun, one of my daily must-read papers, is now the exclusive publisher of my regular columns.

I invite you to consider joining the Sun to receive unlimited access to my latest commentary, alongside some of the finest American journalism.

**But there's also far more to what the Sun is building.

As you know, journalism isn't what it used to be.

I've been in the business for decades, and never before have I seen this once noble profession so abused. The major papers are no longer on the side of the American people, and we are right to withhold our trust.

The impact on our democracy is considerable. Without real accountability, the worst actors in government and at corporate institutions have free reign, and patriotic, hard-working Americans are being sidelined and ignored.

The antidote is to join the movement to build a better alternative. That's the American way.

**The charge to restore American journalism is being led by the Sun.** A proudly all-American, principled publication that has plenty of room for conservative thought and conservative writers, the Sun has upheld the highest journalistic standards since 1833. That's 18 years before the New York Times published its first number.**My decision for the New York Sun to become the exclusive publisher of my regular columns was not taken lightly.**

I value their work and have been impressed by their team, but I know they have a hell of a battle ahead. They are the David facing many Goliaths.

They will only succeed if we join with them in this grassroots national effort. Joining the Sun costs as little as a penny a day. I encourage you to sign up today. Every single person counts.

| Hi, it’s Ritchie. It’s been a while since I introduced myself to you, Peter.

[If you’ve been on Team Ritchie from day 1, you can click here to skip my story and support our grassroots movement »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91773621/494938504/-723981995?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20240829_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxY2Y2ZjliZi0zNDY2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7l-ZA6q4okzDRbrccgv2kooeqAd9Xf3kpWjil3CHuZI=)

**_Here’s a little bit about me:_**

📍 I was born and raised in the Bronx.

🏠 Growing up with a single mom, public housing was a lifeline for my family — so I’ve dedicated my career to fighting for affordable housing and building social safety nets to eliminate poverty.

🏳️🌈 I’m the first openly LGBTQ+ Afro-Latino man in Congress. My lived experience as a gay Black man motivates me to fight _every day_ until we are fully equal in the eyes of the law.

👊🏽 I’m a tireless advocate for Social Security and Medicare. I believe proper health care cannot be limited to physical health, and I’ll continue to advocate tirelessly for access to mental health care.

**_And here’s why my story matters for you:_**

When you invest in this campaign, you’re investing in _community._

From fighting for affordable housing to community initiatives to Medicare and more, I know this grassroots movement is capable of _changing the game_ for the Bronx.

A first look at our upcoming text banks: | | | Hey Peter, What’s at stake this year is bigger than Trump or Harris alone. The moment we stop fighting is the moment we give politicians the power to dictate what we deserve.** MAGA Republicans are attacking our communities from all angles — from hateful anti-immigrant laws to countless threats to our reproductive and human rights. Our collective freedoms are on the line this November. The countdown is on! Election Day is near — and we need all hands on deck in this final stretch. subject: Add your name: Cori Bush on AIPAC - "Their role in my primary was egregious"
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Our Revolution click here to unsubscribe
body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

Peter Willis — Bernie,
Cori Bush, Jamaal Bowman, and many other progressives are warning the
Democratic Party about what will happen if the Party fails to reject AIPAC
and its right-wing donors.

The right-wing pro-Israel lobby is still targeting progressive candidates
— heading into the general election in November and beyond.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19275?source=email-20240829&t=1016&akid=6658%2E5885482%2EnEVCjE ][IMG]

AIPAC is having a dangerous impact on every facet of the Democratic Party.
The Biden administration continues its near-total support of Netanyahu’s
devastating war on Gaza. The DNC even denied Palestinian-Americans a
speaking slot. And AIPAC spent tens of millions of dollars of MAGA money
in Democratic primaries to defeat some of the strongest supporters of
Palestinian human rights: Cori Bush and Jamaal Bowman.

The Democratic Party should NOT put up with a group of right-wing, Trump
donors funding a super PAC to defeat progressives. It’s time for the Party
to Reject AIPAC and its $100 million of anti-progressive campaign
spending.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19275?source=email-20240829&t=1017&akid=6658%2E5885482%2EnEVCjE ]Stand with Bernie, Cori Bush and our movement: Tell the Democratic
Party to keep AIPAC’s money and influence out of Democratic primaries!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19275?source=email-20240829&t=1018&akid=6658%2E5885482%2EnEVCjE ]ADD YOUR NAME

“They were bigoted, they were racist,” Bush said of AIPAC, which spent $9
million against her, including racist mailers featuring photoshopped
pictures of Cori that distorted her face to make her forehead look bigger
and elongate her features.

Bernie warned that AIPAC has an “intimidating presence” over every member
of Congress, because as soon as a lawmaker criticizes Netanyahu’s bombing
campaign against the Palestinian people, the pro-Israel lobby is ready to
throw millions into a campaign to defeat them. Bernie also said of AIPAC,
“I think they smell success.” If we allow the status quo to continue,
AIPAC could defeat every single one of our progressive champions in
Congress.

The bottom line is that AIPAC’s unlimited right-wing spending in our
elections poses an existential threat to our movement.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19275?source=email-20240829&t=1019&akid=6658%2E5885482%2EnEVCjE ][IMG]

It must be one of our top priorities to end the influence of big money in
politics AND pressure the Democratic Party to reject the right-wing money
of AIPAC in primaries.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19275?source=email-20240829&t=1020&akid=6658%2E5885482%2EnEVCjE ]Stand with all of the pro-Peace progressives advocating for peace in
Gaza: Reject AIPAC!

When we organize, we win.

name: Jon Tester
subject: Nearly $90 million
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Seth Moulton for Congress
body:
Hi.

subject: Check out our Second Amendment Coalition!
body:
| | | |
---
|
---

Friend,
As I've been out on the campaign trail, New Hampshire voters are clear that they want a conservative they can trust to deliver as our next Governor!
I've always defended your second amendment rights here in the Granite State. As a Legislator, I supported the ‘Castle Doctrine’ because I believe you deserve the right to defend yourself, your family, and your property against intruders.
As Senate President, I helped draft the legislation for Constitutional Carry, because it should be easy for New Hampshire residents to defend themselves. I was proud to be endorsed by the NRA in 2022, and to have received an A rating from both the NRA and the New Hampshire Firearms Coalition in 2024.
I'm proud to launch the 'Second Amendment Coalition' and stand alongside these dedicated leaders who are committed to fiercely defending our Second Amendment rights here in the 603.
\- Chuck Morse

Nella Domenici’s race in New Mexico is one to watch. |
---
Peter,

When I first decided to run for president, many people told me I couldn’t. They said I was too young; they said I had never run for office before.

They were wrong. America needs outsiders.

And that’s why I want you to know about **Nella Domenici**.

She’s ready to break through the Overton window, [**_but she needs your help._**](http://links.nellanewmexico.com/u/click?_t=bec4f693b6284a4ba56cb04ba05e5b45&_m=2f950205efc248b1a161890db4c3bf70&_e=71_d8ZJiFRN8-eyQuQt7eUvicPrx62S8Sx-SSVKr38xA63SlBL8LTj_aj1vrn_jnFmZn9FBoE6hVg7a6IsxSXGqFFofs1MNG43WJa7kOFGFbaVq6JHJBN_Tg9xEJrxbqJd2Ux0ZwfzIc-YT6naG0y3_pFRfmZQxsDO65LaEE5ssXHmBselJyDteZ_expSmr3IMOaoHXOp7FQFA5K54HRsqABtpZ-wtU_Osa_-SGTZv4JmFRlybv25oo3E-slj34psQQeTWCBknlNDsFkGcyHCme9g6m6rzDIoH71HCEObF9ZXK9bSBVu5TftaZ-erexiBulV6qP_MF_J-S5bcSNaianp6W9nbqsRicSSII8vZuSRRYBa2wBxUZ8U9SAfKjgU6Kwq5sAvj6JHNnhpc-fWsg%3D%3D)

[](http://links.nellanewmexico.com/u/click?_t=bec4f693b6284a4ba56cb04ba05e5b45&_m=2f950205efc248b1a161890db4c3bf70&_e=71_d8ZJiFRN8-eyQuQt7eUvicPrx62S8Sx-SSVKr38xA63SlBL8LTj_aj1vrn_jnFmZn9FBoE6hVg7a6IsxSXGqFFofs1MNG43WJa7kOFGFbaVq6JHJBN_Tg9xEJrxbqJd2Ux0ZwfzIc-YT6naG0y3_pFRfmZQxsDO65LaEE5ssXHmBselJyDteZ_expSmr3IMOaoHXOp7FQFA5K54HRsqABtpZ-wtU_Osa_-SGTZv40n28qOd6bI_bAh6a7m-oXIliC-FHPsEwds4T3MSbNNh3d2G-YaYW8hiqTiEubV-SY0XODb51UKXi6M_XIFS85GUSQRyUlKigrN-OEFV7EKN0iHD-yxI9yrxU-xarbwz9brM6sU4Fk5pRSVwLB-11QHXYbFIzSlZcRJyo5N5zbQg%3D%3D)
Nella is running against a radical Left Democrat who has been in Washington for 15 years. He’s a rubber stamp for the Schumer-Biden-Harris agenda.

She’s ready to help our nation become energy-independent. She’ll vote to secure our border against the dangerous fentanyl poisoning our young people. She will stand up to Kamala Harris’ radical plan for our country.

And, unlike Martin Heinrich, Nella hasn’t been a politician all her life. She is a proven business leader who has actually created American jobs.

And Peter, if you need another reason to stand with Nella today, let me share a piece of the recent polling.

body:
I don’t want to give it too much attention, but Trump spoke in Arizona twice last week, including one time with my opponent, Kari Lake, at a rally in Phoenix.
He laid out his cynical and divisive worldview for the millionth time. He spoke about his extreme, radical, dangerous agenda. And he put us — our campaign — square in the middle of his warpath. He attacked me multiple times, said I "shouldn't even be allowed to run."
But most importantly, he said if he wins in Arizona he wins the presidency. He said it himself: He has to go straight through us to have any chance at winning this November.
But I’ve got a message for him: Show some respect.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-gallego [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-gallego]
After years of attacking and insulting veterans like John McCain, or Gold Star Parents like the Khans, the fallen of Belleau Wood, even Medal of Honor recipients — show some respect for the military, for veterans, and for our families.
We’ve got your number, Donald. And we will not let you win.
This election is going to come down to Trump and Lake versus you and me. Can I count on you to have my back as I take the fight to them from now until November?

name: Tim Sheehy
subject: The traits that define me
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TIM SHEEHY FOR MONTANA<-
body:
-> ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=3363940.633.1.7e78caeea588c069af43daed524ded09 )<-

Fellow Conservative,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, \*\*those are the traits that define me\*\*. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to \*\*launch a campaign for the United States Senate last June. ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=3363940.634.1.6bb1d42bd7d13b39a4f548ac1fb6462e )\*\*

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [_ \*\*many veterans like me\*\* _] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally \*\*sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport\*\* so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _ \*\*“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”\*\* _

Every day it got worse.

Every day it was a disaster.

The adult in the room never materialized.

\*\*Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.\*\* Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden and Kamala Harris could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _ \*\*So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt\*\* _ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

\*\*If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right.\*\* If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, \*\*please do me a quick favor and confirm that I have the correct information on file for you ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=3363940.635.1.c4a4af7b6e27430680b845825a01cc5b )\*\*; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy.

->\*\*JOIN OUR FIGHT

ENLIST WITH TIM TODAY→\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=3363940.636.1.f57577d1158b61611135ee05f8d48549 )<-

It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; \*\*but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer.\*\*

\*\*Unlike Joe Biden and Kamala Harris, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield.\*\* I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free.->\*\*ENLIST WITH TIM

CONFIRM YOUR SUPPORT TODAY→\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=3363940.637.1.9cc4d8141a6b2450db30a53a8b8e679c )<-

I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, \*\*I’m going to need the help of every conservative donor who reads this letter. ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=3363940.638.1.597ab53f0bbc50fedf0fdee10e845220 )\*\*

Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes.

We fought in Iraq, _ \*\*I was there.\*\* _ We fought in Afghanistan, _ \*\*I was there.\*\* _

And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times.

I want to look at my children and tell them, _ \*\*“Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.”\*\* _

\*\*But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it.\*\*

So, Fellow Conservative - that’s what I’m fighting for. I’m fighting to restore faith in our American way of life. I entered the political arena to ensure the sacrifices my friends made weren’t made in vain.

->\*\*HELP ME FLIP THIS SEAT

ELECT A FIGHTER TO THE U.S. SENATE→\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=3363940.639.1.dc0eae48c41134341766c6f9506406bc )<-

For America's Future,

Tim Sheehy

Former Navy SEAL

Republican Candidate for U.S. Senate

-> \*\*CHIP IN TODAY\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=3363940.640.1.f34e6349de52885b2051036b5be9d9d9 )<-

->

\* \* \*

“

"I SERVED AS A NAVY SEAL, BUILT ONE OF THE LARGEST AERIAL FIREFIGHTING COMPANIES IN AMERICA CREATING OVER 200 MONTANA JOBS, AND STARTED A VETERAN-LED CATTLE RANCHING AND FEEDING OPERATION. WHETHER IT WAS IN WAR OR BUSINESS, I SEE PROBLEMS AND SOLVE THEM. AMERICA NEEDS CONSERVATIVE LEADERS WHO LOVE OUR COUNTRY. I'M RUNNING FOR THE U.S. SENATE BECAUSE OUR CAMPAIGN IS ABOUT SERVICE, DUTY, AND COUNTRY — NOT POLITICS AS USUAL."

| Our movement to bring common-sense, conservative solutions to western Maryland is just beginning. We CAN stop reckless government spending, tackle inflation and bring down the cost of living, if you step in and help us. A candidate cannot win an election alone, no matter how right their ideas are. **Will you chip in today and help us meet our fundraising goals by the deadline? The NRCC is committing to a BIG investment in this close race if we can meet our fundraising goals by Saturday. We can’t afford to come short.** If you’re READY to rebuild our country and move on from the disastrous Biden-Harris-Delaney agenda of open borders, high inflation and soaring costs, please help us WIN by chipping in whatever you can.

Neil Parrott

We were going up against the political establishment and a lot of outside spending, and we were doing it without a dime of corporate PAC money. Today, sixteen months and one massive primary victory later, we've proved the doubters wrong. = We've proved that a campaign that is rooted in our community and powered by everyday people can take on special interests and win. Don't get me wrong, Peter; it wasn't easy. Our primary victory was the product of months of hard work. We knocked over 165,000 doors, and spent thousands of hours making calls, hosting events, and registering voters. And in the end, every single vote mattered. That's why we're not taking anything for granted in November. We're going to keep our grassroots momentum going, all the way to the polls on Election Day and beyond. Here’s the latest update my team showed me from ActBlue (as you can see, we’ve seen a sharp drop in donations this month): = = = Look, I get it [first/friends]: Everyone is trying to enjoy the final weeks of summer and the election still feels like it’s in the distance. I’m scared that if we don’t reserve TV ads, GOP Super PACs will buy all the ad inventory. Simply put, if we don’t turn this around now, we risk falling behind in the most critical weeks before the election.
