# FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
August 29, 2024
CONTACT: press@kevinfaulconer.com

**Kevin Faulconer Blasts Terra Lawson-Remer For Failing To Address “Remerville,” The Largest Tent Encampment In San Diego River's History**
SAN DIEGO, CA — Kevin Faulconer, candidate for San Diego County Supervisor, today condemned Supervisor Terra Lawson-Remer for her failure to address the growing humanitarian and environmental disaster along the San Diego River, now known as "Remerville." This sprawling tent encampment, the largest in the river's history, has become a symbol of the county’s negligence under Lawson-Remer’s leadership.
---
[](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=f39e3077b8&e=784f78234b)
[CLICK HERE TO WATCH: “Remerville Part 2”](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=0f1dfb7544&e=784f78234b)
| _**“Under Terra Lawson-Remer’s watch, Remerville has become a tragic stain on our city,” Faulconer said. “Not only is this an environmental catastrophe, with human waste and trash flowing directly into the San Diego River, but it's also a human tragedy. These are real people who have been abandoned to suffer in deplorable conditions. Yet, there's been zero urgency from the County to clean up this mess and provide the help these individuals desperately need. Terra Lawson-Remer’s inaction has created a disaster of historic proportions. It’s time to put an end to the chaos in Remerville and restore sanity and safety to our community.”**_
The encampment, which has swelled in size over recent months, is now home to hundreds of individuals living in squalor. Reports of open-air drug markets, unsanitary conditions, and rising crime have raised serious concerns among residents and environmentalists alike. Despite these alarming developments, the County under Lawson-Remer’s direction has failed to take meaningful action to address the situation. Faulconer emphasized the immediate need for a comprehensive response to this crisis and questioned why the County’s Health Department wasn’t getting involved.
_**“The San Diego River is not just a natural resource; it’s a vital part of our community,” he said. “Allowing this encampment to fester is not only damaging to the environment but also endangering public health and safety. We need leaders who will take decisive action, not sit on the sidelines while our river turns into a toxic dump.”**_
As part of his campaign, Faulconer has pledged to prioritize solutions that will both protect the environment and provide humane assistance to those in need just as he did as San Diego’s mayor where he prioritized keeping the San Diego river clean and clearing tent encampments regularly. As a result of his actions, homelessness went down by double digits during his tenure.
###

name: All On The Line
subject: An ongoing fight for fair maps in Utah
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE NATIONAL REDISTRICTING ACTION FUND
body:
A rushed constitutional amendment that will allow the conservative supermajority to give itself unchecked power
|
---

Peter,
Last week, the Utah Legislature’s conservative supermajority rushed a proposed constitutional amendment to the ballot that, if passed by voters in November, would significantly undermine democracy. It’s a classic example of politicians stripping voters of their power in order to secure more control for themselves.
Here’s a quick overview to get you up to speed on the fight for fair maps in Utah:
* Utah voters have the constitutional right to enact laws through the ballot initiative process.
* In 2018, voters passed Proposition 4, establishing the Utah Independent Redistricting Commission and banning partisan gerrymandering. This was a big victory for the fair maps movement.
* Then in 2020, the Republican-controlled Utah Legislature essentially repealed and replaced Proposition 4, passing a new law that took away the commission’s power to draw the state’s maps.
* With Proposition 4 no longer the law of the land, the legislature enacted new maps that split the most progressive, diverse, and populous county. This was done intentionally to eliminate political competition.
* The League of Women Voters of Utah, Mormon Women for Ethical Government, and residents from Salt Lake County filed a lawsuit claiming the Utah Legislature overstepped when it repealed and replaced Proposition 4.
* This past July, in a huge win for the voters of Utah and democracy more broadly,_the Utah Supreme Court ruled in favor of the voters, and sent the case back to a lower court to determine if the legislature did indeed violate the state constitution!_

**But then, just last week, a group of extreme, right-wing politicians called a last-minute special session to sneak a constitutional amendment onto this November’s ballot, aiming to strip voters of much of their power when passing laws to reform their government.**
[**All On The Line is fighting back against these types of forces that seek to undermine democracy and our freedom. Before we dive into the specifics of what is happening in Utah, can you make a donation to support this important work nationwide?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91783645/494972730/986966146?refcode=don_aotl_redite_email_UTExplain_email_20240829-AOTL-RedLite-UTExplainer_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240829-AOTL-RedLite-UTExplainer_&utm_campaign=UTExplain&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjEzZmY3NjgyLTQ1NjYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ub5oVDp8fTGTB7Wt-K9oG7Ge6gAnFldbvkMRN6kg1JQ=)
The proposed amendment would give the legislature the authority to repeal and replace any citizen-driven ballot initiative, and it would be retroactively applied to previous initiatives. **This would mean the legislature would be giving itself the power to repeal and replace Proposition 4 – what the people of Utah voted for – putting fair maps, and the ability for citizens to check the power of elected officials, at risk.**
The conservative leaders of the Utah Legislature only provided the text of the amendment 24 hours before the vote — and they scheduled this session just days before the final deadline to get initiatives on this November’s ballot. **Though there were hundreds of voters rallying at the Utah Capitol against this proposal, the legislature approved referring this constitutional amendment to voters in November.**
This particular fight for fair maps is far from over. Utahns now get to vote on the constitutional amendment in November. There’s a lot of crucial work to be done to educate voters on the significant impact this amendment will have on democracy.
**The extreme measures that the conservative legislature is pursuing to seize power for themselves _should_ be unbelievable. But we’re seeing things like this happen all across the country. **All On The Line is working day in and day out to push back against discriminatory voting maps, protect the rights of marginalized communities, and achieve a more inclusive democracy for all. But additional attacks on our democracy are coming, and we need your help.
[**Can we count on you to make a donation to All On The Line today to help secure a more representative democracy?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91783646/494972733/986966146?refcode=don_aotl_redite_email_UTExplain_email_20240829-AOTL-RedLite-UTExplainer_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240829-AOTL-RedLite-UTExplainer_&utm_campaign=UTExplain&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjEzZmY3NjgyLTQ1NjYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ub5oVDp8fTGTB7Wt-K9oG7Ge6gAnFldbvkMRN6kg1JQ=)

clean_body: A rushed constitutional amendment that will allow the conservative supermajority to give itself unchecked power | Peter, Last week, the Utah Legislature’s conservative supermajority rushed a proposed constitutional amendment to the ballot that, if passed by voters in November, would significantly undermine democracy. It’s a classic example of politicians stripping voters of their power in order to secure more control for themselves. Here’s a quick overview to get you up to speed on the fight for fair maps in Utah: Utah voters have the constitutional right to enact laws through the ballot initiative process. In 2018, voters passed Proposition 4, establishing the Utah Independent Redistricting Commission and banning partisan gerrymandering. This was a big victory for the fair maps movement. Then in 2020, the Republican-controlled Utah Legislature essentially repealed and replaced Proposition 4, passing a new law that took away the commission’s power to draw the state’s maps. With Proposition 4 no longer the law of the land, the legislature enacted new maps that split the most progressive, diverse, and populous county. This was done intentionally to eliminate political competition. The League of Women Voters of Utah, Mormon Women for Ethical Government, and residents from Salt Lake County filed a lawsuit claiming the Utah Legislature overstepped when it repealed and replaced Proposition 4. This past July, in a huge win for the voters of Utah and democracy more broadly,the Utah Supreme Court ruled in favor of the voters, and sent the case back to a lower court to determine if the legislature did indeed violate the state constitution! But then, just last week, a group of extreme, right-wing politicians called a last-minute special session to sneak a constitutional amendment onto this November’s ballot, aiming to strip voters of much of their power when passing laws to reform their government. = The proposed amendment would give the legislature the authority to repeal and replace any citizen-driven ballot initiative, and it would be retroactively applied to previous initiatives. This would mean the legislature would be giving itself the power to repeal and replace Proposition 4 – what the people of Utah voted for – putting fair maps, and the ability for citizens to check the power of elected officials, at risk. The conservative leaders of the Utah Legislature only provided the text of the amendment 24 hours before the vote — and they scheduled this session just days before the final deadline to get initiatives on this November’s ballot. Though there were hundreds of voters rallying at the Utah Capitol against this proposal, the legislature approved referring this constitutional amendment to voters in November. This particular fight for fair maps is far from over. Utahns now get to vote on the constitutional amendment in November. There’s a lot of crucial work to be done to educate voters on the significant impact this amendment will have on democracy. The extreme measures that the conservative legislature is pursuing to seize power for themselves should be unbelievable. But we’re seeing things like this happen all across the country. All On The Line is working day in and day out to push back against discriminatory voting maps, protect the rights of marginalized communities, and achieve a more inclusive democracy for all. clean_body: We need your support to pass the care agenda. Hi Peter, Election Day is nearly two months away, with early voting rapidly approaching. There’s so much at stake this November, and we all need to do our part at the ballot box to advance the care agenda. In our key states Arizona, Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Virginia, and Nevada, Care Champions are on the ballot, and the margins between victory and defeat will be razor‐thin. If we all make our voices heard — no matter what state we live in — we can achieve incredible victories like higher wages and better benefits for care workers, and expanded funding for child care, aging care, and disability care. But that means we need to elect leaders who will fight for these policies and advocate for workers and families at the local, state, and national levels. And we can’t elect these Care Champions if any of us stay home in November! In solidarity, Hillary Holley Executive Director | Care in Action

If your inbox is anything like mine, it's stuffed to the gills with fundraising requests from candidates and organizations asking for money ahead of the election.
I am frequently amazed that anyone sifts through these, opens, and donates.
But now you're here. You've opened. You're reading, and because you probably know most of these messages are fundraising requests, maybe you'll consider a donation.
So how do I convince you to do just that?
Well, I cannot promise you your donation will be triple-matched (those are fake). And there's no *official* end-of-month deadline either.
But what I can tell you is that every donation we receive today will fund a plan to reach the voters we need to win this race before early voting starts.
And I can tell you that this race is close, and our ability to reach our fundraising goals is quite literally the difference between winning and losing — between a Democratic and Republican Senate.
So of all the emails in your inbox, a donation here will have an outsized impact. It could determine control of the Senate. It could determine who wins in Michigan because our race will impact the presidential race.
Obviously you care — you've made it this far – and if you were to pick a campaign where your money matters most, this is it. So please:
[**Can you use this link to make a contribution to my Senate campaign today? I would be grateful for any amount you can give today because it all adds up fast toward our budget goals. clean_body: If your inbox is anything like mine, it's stuffed to the gills with fundraising requests from candidates and organizations asking for money ahead of the election. I am frequently amazed that anyone sifts through these, opens, and donates. But now you're here. You've opened. You're reading, and because you probably know most of these messages are fundraising requests, maybe you'll consider a donation. So how do I convince you to do just that? Well, I cannot promise you your donation will be triple-matched (those are fake). And there's no official end-of-month deadline either. But what I can tell you is that every donation we receive today will fund a plan to reach the voters we need to win this race before early voting starts. And I can tell you that this race is close, and our ability to reach our fundraising goals is quite literally the difference between winning and losing — between a Democratic and Republican Senate. So of all the emails in your inbox, a donation here will have an outsized impact. It could determine control of the Senate. It could determine who wins in Michigan because our race will impact the presidential race. Obviously you care — you've made it this far – and if you were to pick a campaign where your money matters most, this is it. So please: If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly:_ | | ** | | | | | | | ** Thank you for caring enough to make a difference. Elissa PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN P.O. Box 4145 East Lansing, MI 48826

body:
The story behind the sweat.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91785731/494980011/1328794144?refcode=ea.92ea621c-4a66-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.92ea621c-4a66-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjkyZWE2MjFjLTRhNjYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=GS7zrbJ6IcSPeRJnEmN2ByZ2AgFyvjibw9uuLWhIYcg=&emci=a8aa3dc0-b364-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&emdi=92ea621c-4a66-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4823105)
---
You know me as an actor, an activist, and yes, the woman in leg warmers from those workout tapes. But there’s a story behind all that sweat, and it’s a story I’m proud to share. Before I do, I have a really quick favor to ask: **[Would you be able to chip in a few dollars today to power our critical work at JanePAC and elect climate champions in November?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91785732/494980012/2105508926?refcode=ea.92ea621c-4a66-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.92ea621c-4a66-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjkyZWE2MjFjLTRhNjYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=GS7zrbJ6IcSPeRJnEmN2ByZ2AgFyvjibw9uuLWhIYcg=)** Back in the early ’80s, I wasn’t just looking for a way to get fit or help others get fit — I was on a mission. My then-husband, Tom Hayden, and I had founded the California Campaign for Economic Democracy (C.E.D.), an organization committed to tackling the social, political, and economic issues that were threatening our communities. We were determined to make a real difference, but we needed funding to keep our work going strong. I realized that the only other business I knew besides acting was exercise. So, I thought, why not combine my passion for fitness with my commitment to activism? And that’s how the _Jane Fonda Workout_ was born. Those VHS tapes weren’t just about sculpting muscles — they were about fueling a movement. And let me tell you, I never imagined those videos would take off the way they did. We’re talking millions of copies sold, and every penny of profit went straight to the C.E.D. to support our campaigns. **Your mom’s leg lifts and lunges helped fund the fight against toxic chemical dumps in California, to push for protective environmental policies, and to support liberal candidates who were ready to take on the big issues.** Fast forward to today, and I’m still in the fight. At 86, I might not be cranking out any more workout tapes, but I am still working out and I am still fighting for change! We’re up against powerful forces — the kind that don’t take a break — but just like those workout tapes, every bit of support adds up to something much bigger. We’re taking on the greedy fossil fuel giants together, and trust me, we can’t do it without you! **[Will you be part of this journey with me? Every donation, no matter how big or small, will help us elect climate champions and power our movement for a sustainable future in November and beyond.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91785733/494980013/2105508926?refcode=ea.92ea621c-4a66-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.92ea621c-4a66-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjkyZWE2MjFjLTRhNjYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=GS7zrbJ6IcSPeRJnEmN2ByZ2AgFyvjibw9uuLWhIYcg=)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | [**DONATE $5**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91785734/494980014/2105508926?express_lane=true&amount=5&refcode=ea.92ea621c-4a66-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.92ea621c-4a66-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjkyZWE2MjFjLTRhNjYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=GS7zrbJ6IcSPeRJnEmN2ByZ2AgFyvjibw9uuLWhIYcg=) | [**DONATE $25**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91785735/494980015/2105508926?express_lane=true&amount=25&refcode=ea.92ea621c-4a66-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.92ea621c-4a66-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjkyZWE2MjFjLTRhNjYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=GS7zrbJ6IcSPeRJnEmN2ByZ2AgFyvjibw9uuLWhIYcg=)

clean_body: The story behind the sweat. | You know me as an actor, an activist, and yes, the woman in leg warmers from those workout tapes. But there’s a story behind all that sweat, and it’s a story I’m proud to share. Before I do, I have a really quick favor to ask: = Back in the early ’80s, I wasn’t just looking for a way to get fit or help others get fit — I was on a mission. My then-husband, Tom Hayden, and I had founded the California Campaign for Economic Democracy (C.E.D.), an organization committed to tackling the social, political, and economic issues that were threatening our communities. We were determined to make a real difference, but we needed funding to keep our work going strong. I realized that the only other business I knew besides acting was exercise. So, I thought, why not combine my passion for fitness with my commitment to activism? And that’s how the Jane Fonda Workout was born. Those VHS tapes weren’t just about sculpting muscles — they were about fueling a movement. And let me tell you, I never imagined those videos would take off the way they did. We’re talking millions of copies sold, and every penny of profit went straight to the C.E.D. to support our campaigns. Your mom’s leg lifts and lunges helped fund the fight against toxic chemical dumps in California, to push for protective environmental policies, and to support liberal candidates who were ready to take on the big issues. Fast forward to today, and I’m still in the fight. At 86, I might not be cranking out any more workout tapes, but I am still working out and I am still fighting for change! We’re up against powerful forces — the kind that don’t take a break — but just like those workout tapes, every bit of support adds up to something much bigger. We’re taking on the greedy fossil fuel giants together, and trust me, we can’t do it without you! = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Let’s keep pushing, keep sweating, and keep fighting for what we believe in. subject: The gate to Kabul's airport
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TIM SHEEHY FOR MONTANA
body:
I want to look at my children and tell them, “Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.” | [](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=6c651fc33f924088a1e131ef5efeb160&_e=L0TAmKVfLhwdu1SsJ-NA1YXuIjYTibROvqqeHbUPnMg0WGQARWb0jnH3VGg_Cvg-CbZDIu2yqdnFXHTQYGrfY0nKyTqe__fBIiEbE_BhoVkeU35isMhr8F6skKTDktb62dsectjlpEUmFHa7hV7D3fJQNQLsWauLp0Zve8Z9iV3-WSIvEaB76fMohZcP50UAPgBKujJdarYqyf_RjlD4fnKNezQJZIzQ4LvTOVnwB6u29nbrwJ27qgwThVks3WdUEUBC2kwaGoPASZWGitDJwRoNWnz8u2reYkPfPZH-RNvZ5FeCSw9mZNpNiLgs49hIjjiYpO6llm3qoNRnDvDVwZT2fgc-uRgBqPul1eguNPZMJ8Y1S0qhQvjpBorw319g24CoMglytKzQle5YV7rYCfWNhqFUofAppO3tQAQUB_IWj_HPylf-ADM1fTgvN11o)

---
Peter,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate last June.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=6c651fc33f924088a1e131ef5efeb160&_e=L0TAmKVfLhwdu1SsJ-NA1YXuIjYTibROvqqeHbUPnMg0WGQARWb0jnH3VGg_Cvg-CbZDIu2yqdnFXHTQYGrfY0nKyTqe__fBIiEbE_BhoVkeU35isMhr8F6skKTDktb62dsectjlpEUmFHa7hV7D3fJQNQLsWauLp0Zve8Z9iV3-WSIvEaB76fMohZcP50UAPgBKujJdarYqyf_RjlD4fnKNezQJZIzQ4LvTOVnwB6u29nbrwJ27qgwThVks3WdUEUBC2kwaGoPASZWGitDJwSrMqB8VTbFSD5bgGog282hTod2JtEq5H4n2aLnLgTxyGeAKZflt08J1bAHuH-TIWf8usQczPPPxCjqLKgdSlnOgRQQmURu3fkstQGDAHC0tD5f5tRU7u79a2Qph5051HgSEqkgY2FeV8PE19njh7P2nNCBYhv8ecWePv2NRktdE)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [_**many veterans like me**_] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=6c651fc33f924088a1e131ef5efeb160&_e=L0TAmKVfLhwdu1SsJ-NA1YXuIjYTibROvqqeHbUPnMg0WGQARWb0jnH3VGg_Cvg-CbZDIu2yqdnFXHTQYGrfY0nKyTqe__fBIiEbE_BhoVkeU35isMhr8F6skKTDktb62dsectjlpEUmFHa7hV7D3fJQNQLsWauLp0Zve8Z9iV3-WSIvEaB76fMohZcP50UAPgBKujJdarYqyf_RjlD4fnKNezQJZIzQ4LvTOVnwB6u29nbrwJ27qgwThVks3WdUEUBC2kwaGoPASZWGitDJwdtTNkpmhRUU8nYMiS3aBY4O48yjWeGSpIan8Gunn3oiRPDzqVP48aZQ0K7icDgy_XTcpsfG6_WlaQWf1EeRge7tOQ0vhJk65u9Tvx4pqhB1kQcX6kzJ88WbdzsqOG3SBf2Z6SK0JILo-M78_C_JmqXWHl8rrytmk888HAPumxQ8)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

This is special, friend — **it’s officially been over a year since we launched this campaign for U.S. Senate.**
For the last year, we've been fighting hard to reach Floridians and speak to who Rick Scott truly is: a failed leader who has put the extremist policies of Donald Trump and his own self-interest above all else. Floridians are catching on, as Rick Scott's approval rating is abysmally tanking.
But this was never just about Rick Scott. It's about you, the people, in Florida — and all over the nation — who deserve a true public servant looking out for your interests. Service has, and always will be, at the heart of everything I do. When I'm in the Senate, I'll fight with everything I have to move the needle on the issues that actually impact your everyday life.
And together, I know we can win and make a difference. So whether you've been on this team with me for the last 365 days, if you joined last week, or even if you joined today, I want to say this: **Thank you so much. I couldn't have come this far without you, and I can't win on Election Day without you. I'm so grateful for your grassroots support.**
This past year has been a whirlwind in all the best ways. I've toured all over Florida and spoke with so many amazing voters across our diverse, beautiful communities. I've spread our message across the airwaves, starting with Spanish ads. **And thanks to our hard work,****recent polling shows us statistically tied with Rick Scott.**
But now is where the real work begins. I'm the official Democratic nominee for this Senate race, and with just 68 days to go, we must fight with everything we've got to win this race — because if we do, it will virtually guarantee a Democratic Senate majority.

Hey friends,

As a Member of Congress and former CIA officer, I have taken an oath multiple times to protect and defend the Constitution, and I’ve seen how fragile democracy is, especially when extremists are undermining our institutions and sowing distrust. Like many Americans, I have been proud that our institutions held, not just during Trump’s four-year presidency but in the aftermath of the 2020 election and amid the efforts he led to undermine and overturn the results of that election. However, our institutions did not hold on their own. They endured because people stood up for and defended them—individuals ranging from Administration appointees and Members of Congress to local and state officials, as well as fellow Americans who spoke out with honesty. We’re facing one of the final end-of-month fundraising deadlines of this campaign – and we need your help.
While our MAGA opponent Pete Stauber is busy reposting dangerous pro-Trump propaganda on social media, we’re out in the community talking to voters and earning their support. We can win, but only with your help. So please, donate whatever you can right away! → [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/schultz-august-2024?refcode=20240829]
– Team Schultz

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/schultz-august-2024?refcode=20240829 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/schultz-august-2024?refcode=20240829]
Friends,
We’re closing in on Labor Day weekend – the unofficial marker of entering the “final stretch” toward Election Day. But first we’re facing a critical end-of-month fundraising deadline. Before I ask you to make a donation to help us reach our goal [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/schultz-august-2024?refcode=20240828] , I want to tell you why I’ve never been more confident about this election.
After an incredible week with Minnesota Democrats in Chicago for the DNC, including our next Vice President Tim Walz, I can feel an energy we haven’t felt in a long, long time. But I can also feel that same energy on the ground in every community across the 8th district.
The choice that voters have this year couldn’t be more stark in contrast. On one side we have Donald Trump and Pete Stauber, who continually stoop to new lows and baseless attacks. If my two boys talked to their classmates the way that they do, I know I’d be expecting a call from the principal’s office.
But on the other side, Democrats are leading with joy, compassion, and an unwavering promise to work hard to make life better for working families.
Momentum continues to grow for our positive vision for the future, but we need to keep it going every single day until Election Day. If we take our foot off the gas, we could wake up on November 6th with the same feeling we had in 2016.
I know we’re not going to let that happen. So please, make a donation to our campaign today to help us reach one of our final end-of-month fundraising deadlines of this campaign. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/schultz-august-2024?refcode=20240829]

body:
Peter, did you catch me on MSNBC this week? ⬇️ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91788877/494990747/1368611189?refcode=EM_F_240828Split_N_SB_90DO_7_G_N_P1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzg0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMzcxMjIxNi01MjY2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=b5JR7O2chZaVhcFRZqcoXI12h2a8FcmGs3dZGJD_Hy0=) It's all good if you missed it, but here's what I want you to know: I'm in this fight for you, Peter, and for working families across the country who want to build a better life for themselves and their children.

**But while I'm in the Senate fighting to lower prescription drug costs, increase wages, and protect the Dignity of Work, my MAGA opponent, Bernie Moreno, is busy aligning himself with Donald Trump, JD Vance, and their dangerous Project 2025 agenda.**

Now look, I've been knocking on doors and chatting with everyday Ohioans on the campaign trail, and let me tell you, they have no interest in the mess that is Bernie Moreno and Project 2025. Banning abortion, cutting Social Security and Medicare, stripping voting rights – _I mean come on!_

What’s for dinner?
Who’s picking up the kids?
Is the car still making a funny noise?
Is the dog due for a vet visit?
Are we finally finished with this heat?
**What will our country look like next year? **
Derek, if you’re anything like me, you’re trying to answer all of these questions and many more on a typical day. And if you’re like me, you’re worried about what will happen if Democrats don’t prevail in November. I get it. **Juggling your everyday concerns with worries over the future of our democracy is simply exhausting. **
I’d like to take at least one question off your mind: _Does my representative in DC have my back?_ Every day, the best interests of my constituents and this country are top of mind for me. My goal is simple (yet at times so exceedingly complicated!): creating and passing legislation that improves our lives. That might mean protecting our rights or our environment. It might mean focusing on our economy or our border.
Whatever the pressing issues of the day, ** I can’t keep working on solutions if I’m not reelected. ** And I will accomplish a whole lot more working beside a Democratic president and a Democratic-majority Congress.
**If you give today, it will help pay for lunch so our volunteers can hit the ground and knock doors. It pays for yard signs and campaign literature so we can get our message out across Chester and Berks counties. And it pays for our huge voter registration efforts, which make sure people come out on November 5 and keep PA-06 blue.**
**[Can you help out with a contribution today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91788999/494990944/685235109?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1036-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMjcxMjIxNi01MjY2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dN-YmsreEpJtxQWMcBzxj0Ri-A0uJgOaGJ4JqlEzKOc=)** I don’t take your time or your money for granted and thank you for your ongoing commitment and support!

What will our country look like next year? Derek, if you’re anything like me, you’re trying to answer all of these questions and many more on a typical day. And if you’re like me, you’re worried about what will happen if Democrats don’t prevail in November. I get it. Juggling your everyday concerns with worries over the future of our democracy is simply exhausting. I’d like to take at least one question off your mind: Does my representative in DC have my back? Every day, the best interests of my constituents and this country are top of mind for me. My goal is simple (yet at times so exceedingly complicated!): creating and passing legislation that improves our lives. That might mean protecting our rights or our environment. It might mean focusing on our economy or our border. Whatever the pressing issues of the day, I can’t keep working on solutions if I’m not reelected. And I will accomplish a whole lot more working beside a Democratic president and a Democratic-majority Congress. If you give today, it will help pay for lunch so our volunteers can hit the ground and knock doors. Right now, we’re building the largest grassroots team Texas has ever seen to defeat Ted Cruz and flip Texas blue.

| Folks, I got to speak at the Democratic National Convention last week, and I have to tell you: the energy that Democrats have right now – the energy that was in this completely packed building – is unlike anything I’ve ever felt before.

Everywhere I look, I'm seeing people who are hopeful and excited about this election – and it's not just what I felt last week. I've been feeling it in Dallas and San Antonio and all across Texas, too.

That's how I know we're going to win this race. I've been saying since day one of this campaign that we're going to defeat Ted Cruz and protect our Senate majority – now, I need people like you behind me to get us across the finish line.

I’m honored to be the Democratic nominee for the U.S. Senate from Texas. I’m a fourth-generation Texan, and everything I’ve done in my life – from making it to the NFL, to law school, and finally to Congress – is thanks to opportunities that Texas has given me. In my Texas, we believe that WE is more powerful than ME.

But Ted Cruz doesn’t believe in the Texas that I know and love. He doesn’t believe you should help your neighbors when things get tough. He doesn’t believe that our seniors deserve the Social Security and Medicare they have earned. He doesn’t believe that women should be able to make their own health care decisions.

**All Ted Cruz cares about is himself – and Texas deserves much better than a me-guy who runs to Cancun when we’re in crisis.

Right now, we’re building the largest grassroots team Texas has ever seen to defeat Ted Cruz and flip Texas blue. But he’s got an army of right-wing donors and far-right super PACs behind him, and I can’t win this race without your support.**

I've been feeling it in Dallas and San Antonio and all across Texas, too. That's how I know we're going to win this race. I've been saying since day one of this campaign that we're going to defeat Ted Cruz and protect our Senate majority – now, I need people like you behind me to get us across the finish line. = | = I’m honored to be the Democratic nominee for the U.S. Senate from Texas. I’m a fourth-generation Texan, and everything I’ve done in my life – from making it to the NFL, to law school, and finally to Congress – is thanks to opportunities that Texas has given me. All Ted Cruz cares about is himself – and Texas deserves much better than a me-guy who runs to Cancun when we’re in crisis. Peter,

When I first decided to run for president, many people told me I couldn’t. They said I was too young; they said I had never run for office before.

They were wrong. America needs outsiders.

And that’s why I want you to know about **Nella Domenici**.

She’s ready to break through the Overton window, [**_but she needs your help._**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=6e3ed8c140cf46d284dccc075dd2aee7&_e=Ap9b5ChwRQuanNb68rlZqegSMokfPiNeuC9U2313Ei8N2Sj5bZ1mL8QBg2GeMR7yl2b9i7OYfwiggV2ZA2fzH9rqDZolzv7RV5-gUnDTEJg57zhLcsfXmGUThdjJ87L1AC5g2SaR456axmRUaP8dlbo8S3nt4hXWuQFT5GvcreI3VrzCrzzW9j_IFBYQ2dQK_nuSaphg7MsasoTj1AsqMMxkMlRkI2GXrkDlEswuZBTYvVts5MWXjEy97J2VVLl5zTib6vnbT5fBF1vhkR_GNygLKODd1iCLP0jm0bvQqLIqmtYRd95xWyzpDtI0gpcA9mBNqOVL_BNnQWp-gfxZKzXi2bEySFjL8RXy381EPJcy76_pE8jvDH-f96lMylhjiJsxNXw9tfLmyonE8ocOBg%3D%3D)

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=6e3ed8c140cf46d284dccc075dd2aee7&_e=Ap9b5ChwRQuanNb68rlZqegSMokfPiNeuC9U2313Ei8N2Sj5bZ1mL8QBg2GeMR7yl2b9i7OYfwiggV2ZA2fzH9rqDZolzv7RV5-gUnDTEJg57zhLcsfXmGUThdjJ87L1AC5g2SaR456axmRUaP8dlbo8S3nt4hXWuQFT5GvcreI3VrzCrzzW9j_IFBYQ2dQK_nuSaphg7MsasoTj1AsqMMxkMlRkI2GXrkDlEswuZBRzlNgTdQ8apaMjiQN5vgSsX7EbMEzABR1P2h4YpdVZgUsWwpFV4P76r876P3jKMIlUzo8LGTa-fGw8ZGShLVMgSz4faEjbOtZ0MmEwWJmd_aJPxg7EX4y9yaz7jhz2p54zuxCqW04iqj_rAlNqp9_r6fU_J6k4xOOgov127Wc9ww%3D%3D)
Nella is running against a radical Left Democrat who has been in Washington for 15 years. He’s a rubber stamp for the Schumer-Biden-Harris agenda.

She’s ready to help our nation become energy-independent. She’ll vote to secure our border against the dangerous fentanyl poisoning our young people. She will stand up to Kamala Harris’ radical plan for our country.

And, unlike Martin Heinrich, Nella hasn’t been a politician all her life. She is a proven business leader who has actually created American jobs.

And Peter, if you need another reason to stand with Nella today, let me share a piece of the recent polling.

**21 percent of voters are UNDECIDED.**

That means this seat – much to the chagrin of the Left – is up for grabs.

[**Peter, I am personally asking for your help – will you join me in supporting Nella Domenici for Senate?**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=6e3ed8c140cf46d284dccc075dd2aee7&_e=Ap9b5ChwRQuanNb68rlZqegSMokfPiNeuC9U2313Ei8N2Sj5bZ1mL8QBg2GeMR7yl2b9i7OYfwiggV2ZA2fzH9rqDZolzv7RV5-gUnDTEJg57zhLcsfXmGUThdjJ87L1AC5g2SaR456axmRUaP8dlbo8S3nt4hXWuQFT5GvcreI3VrzCrzzW9j_IFBYQ2dQK_nuSaphg7MsasoTj1AsqMMxkMlRkI2GXrkDlEswuZBSbsTkk47m521-sdM_QrgPWXyy-bGq194PNUgaKVTjVYKXK2cQtbNlHE9QiAQo26oeerri0brF_zs7QblsV8MzSrxL9yZHq14AiV7OIZhNwW9B5OZaQHngoU0nlS0Mc5hV4rv9-i6amcfWVjNcXpGN_s-K_5JMK8zkX1TIKXIppuw%3D%3D)

Thanks,

Vivek Ramaswamy

[ ** Help Nella Flip New Mexico » **](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=6e3ed8c140cf46d284dccc075dd2aee7&_e=Ap9b5ChwRQuanNb68rlZqegSMokfPiNeuC9U2313Ei8N2Sj5bZ1mL8QBg2GeMR7yl2b9i7OYfwiggV2ZA2fzH9rqDZolzv7RV5-gUnDTEJg57zhLcsfXmGUThdjJ87L1AC5g2SaR456axmRUaP8dlbo8S3nt4hXWuQFT5GvcreI3VrzCrzzW9j_IFBYQ2dQK_nuSaphg7MsasoTj1AsqMMxkMlRkI2GXrkDlEswuZBScVN2t0v87fNUCHnJQ6N8IOj-_jzeG6R3vW3r7WiHVCPGBOzhWKgfdcGzrqK0Ti4gvd1kwDpaccbri1mPEN6-w9Rk-edNFhdpFJwX_GIGiEugm7osp7swQkcJgwJTUzbhrLRWFmU8naKez9QWJK-ab0ijSDbwtxfpScnC69pwmsg%3D%3D)

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

[ ** JOIN NELLA **](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=6e3ed8c140cf46d284dccc075dd2aee7&_e=Ap9b5ChwRQuanNb68rlZqegSMokfPiNeuC9U2313Ei8N2Sj5bZ1mL8QBg2GeMR7yl2b9i7OYfwiggV2ZA2fzH9rqDZolzv7RV5-gUnDTEJg57zhLcsfXmGUThdjJ87L1AC5g2SaR456axmRUaP8dlbo8S3nt4hXWuQFT5GvcreI3VrzCrzzW9j_IFBYQ2dQK_nuSaphg7MsasoTj1AsqMMxkMlRkI2GXrkDlEswuZBRBvcywFnTCsx7JMGuuR1Wz7Y12jowq-uH6GqXe-933nuAGzcIaarj_H8ABcXRJQpJQs5tKFtaDz252gP9T1gCoLTyemKiRxLWhWSjtMtmNUOgytdGNUzCkFjL1B_Bwu4GhD7g26LDb9k3QzyTJGpbzZg7gHaJ4BufVD1JmrvsWlw%3D%3D)

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

AIPAC and its Republican-funded super PACs are trying to take over the
Democratic Party. They’re forcing progressives to turn a blind eye to mass
protests and calls to stop Israel’s bombs.

They’re taking out progressive incumbents like Cori Bush and Jamaal Bowman
by using $25 million dollars of right-wing money to influence Democratic
Party primaries from the outside.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240829.7lxS8i&refcode=em20240829-35950&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=35950%2E1203867%2EjE03Ya ]We need the resources to fight back against the Democratic
establishment as we continue to fight for our values. Please donate today
to help us reach our end-of-month fundraising goal!

Intercept reporter Akela Lacy illustrated how AIPAC has been spending
heavily against progressives. Lacy’s recent Intercept article details her
interview with Cori Bush, Summer Lee, and Delia Ramirez.

Cori Bush said:

“Democrats should be concerned about AIPAC’s role in the party’s
primaries. That was just my race, but what will they do next? Because what
they’re ultimately trying to do is move Democrats further to the right.”

Delia Ramirez shared:

“Every single Democrat should be concerned that one or two super PACs were
able to concentrate $18 million to take out a Democrat, and that so much
of that money came from Republicans. You put $18 million against Leader
Jeffries — he’s in trouble. Every one of us is in trouble. What AIPAC did
should be criminal.”

Summer Lee pointed out:

“What AIPAC knows is that the Bronx or the Mon Valley where I’m from, or
St. Louis and Ferguson, those communities don’t have $20 million sitting
in them. They know that, and that’s the reason why they come into those
districts.”

We can’t let AIPAC replace us with a clone of the Republican Party. We are
in a fight for the soul of the Democratic Party. We need the resources to
stand up to AIPAC and support our candidates who have been calling out for
a ceasefire.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240829.7lxS8i&refcode=em20240829-35950&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=35950%2E1203867%2EjE03Ya ]In order to continue our critical work of electing progressives,
please, rush a donation of $5 or any amount today before

body:
In 1910, my grandfather came to Montana
| | |
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91790709/494996375/1318177582?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1804-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTQ5ZGY1ZTAtNTQ2Ni1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=TfmkEZOcwY7nZcultJxkAlF_QVv194RujVR-3JrafZw=)
In 1910, my grandfather came to Montana. He found a piece of grassy land, took a look at it, and said, “This is the place.” And that’s where the farm began.
He farmed the land until the early 1940s, and then passed it down to my folks. In 1978, my wife Sharla and I took over the farm and we’re still here today, three generations and more than 40 years later.
We’ve made a lot of progress here — Sharla and I built a new home, several steel buildings, and more storage.
The truth is, I love this work. Yes, it makes for early mornings and late nights during planting and harvest seasons — but it also keeps me grounded, and it gives me perspective on the issues we face every day.
When I think about climate change, I’m thinking of folks on farms like mine, struggling with catastrophic droughts or historic levels of flooding. When I think about reforming the USPS, I’m thinking of the people in rural communities across Montana who rely on timely mail delivery for their medication or Social Security checks. And when I think about infrastructure, I’m thinking of the rural towns near mine that need access to affordable, high-speed internet.

We’ve got three days to go until our August fundraising deadline hits. That’s midnight on Saturday if you’re keeping track.

Friends,
All of our hard work is paying off!
A brand new poll shows that I’m within striking distance of Jim Jordan. The more people hear about our campaign, the more they say, “That’s who I want representing me in Congress.”
But we’re not getting complacent – we’re taking it up a notch. Our next move?
Billboards.
We want to plaster our name and message all over the district so everyone knows there’s a better choice this November.
In fact, we’re about to start with this one right around the corner from Jim Jordan’s house:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240829_billboards_image [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240829_billboards_image]
We’re ready to make a statement that can’t be ignored, but we need your help to get these billboards up. Every dollar you contribute will help us take this fight directly to the voters and keep the pressure on Jim Jordan. Let’s show everyone that Ohio is ready for real change—contribute today to make it happen! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240829_billboards_link]

We’ve been doing an incredible job of showing folks that there’s a better option—a campaign that’s not interested in making noise but making a real difference.
We’re focused on bringing down the everyday costs like gas and groceries that are crushing families, expanding healthcare access (including protecting women’s reproductive rights), and standing up for our veterans and seniors.
But to keep this momentum going, we need to make sure every voter in the district sees our message and gets familiar with our campaign.
That’s why we’re fundraising for billboards. We’re ready to take this race to the next level but need your help to fuel our billboard budget.
So, if you’re as fed up with Jim Jordan’s antics as we are, now’s the time to act.
Let’s get our name out there, loud and proud, and show the country that Ohio is ready for change. Your contribution today will make sure that every single voter knows who’s really fighting for them. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240829_billboards_link2]
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

subject: A real person wrote this email.

body:
#
Can we be real with you for a moment?
We understand that a constant stream of emails asking for a contribution can sometimes get on your nerves. That’s okay. Real people wrote this email, we get them as well. We understand how people can get frustrated. _But let us explain why this is vital._
When we’re asking for your support, we don’t expect every person to give. But we ask because we know that when you can support the cause, you will. That’s how this transformative movement works.**It’s a whole lot of people doing their part to make something great.**
[Right now, we’re just 3 days away from the end of the month, and we’re hoping to hit our August fundraising targets before then. The only way we can get there is through the support of small-dollar donors chipping in whatever they can. If you can, will you make a $3 contribution — or $5, or anything you can — right now? It’ll go a long way.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240829.pK4fkw&refcode=em20240829-7107-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7107%2E2526796%2E86X1uq)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240829.pK4fkw&refcode=em20240829-7107-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=7107%2E2526796%2E86X1uq)**
We’re not exaggerating. Most members of Congress fuel their reelection campaigns by dedicating hours of their time asking rich donors for $500, $1000, or even $3300 donations.
**Alexandria is different.** This whole movement is fueled by online contributions like the ones we’re asking for in this email. With these contributions, we’ve built a campaign that is...
1. Raising resources, recruiting volunteers, and making calls to help elect progressive allies across Congress, and build a progressive majority.
2. Reaching out to communities across NY-14 and the country to spread awareness about the Green New Deal, how to influence local, state, and federal leaders, and more.
3. Raising money for community relief organizations, closing critical resources gaps that the federal government has left unfilled.
4. Working day and night to reelect AOC, defeat our Republican opponents, and show the world what we can do.

[If this movement is the model of what you want in our politics, please donate today.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240829.pK4fkw&refcode=em20240829-7107-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=7107%2E2526796%2E86X1uq)
Thanks for reading,
Team AOC
**[Contribute $3](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240829.pK4fkw&refcode=em20240829-7107-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=7107%2E2526796%2E86X1uq)**

JD Vance calls himself “pro-family” and says he wants kids to have more of a voice in our country. He even made the outrageous proposal “to give votes to all children” and let their parents have control over those votes.

But the truth is that Vance, Donald Trump, and the rest of the MAGA Republicans support policies that couldn’t be worse for children.

The true defenders of children are Democrats like Kamala Harris and Tim Walz, who’ve dedicated their entire careers to making our schools safer, our families healthier, and our nation stronger.

[**Their Future PAC is working tirelessly to elect Kids First Candidates like Harris and Walz this November, but we can’t do it alone. Can you donate towards our $16,000 goal before our critical end-of-month deadline on August 31?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsm92z_9kg8EwjzhMXy50svo6CRQJo1Q8B6OnUAI0vBI49tvIyQCuYX9FdNdp_1ooNFbLUtdefyQFgRSDVsoTAXt5SUVz43MTNWMWKMmSMWhPdU5XMof_p8Q4f0jRkA0UfUa-LejJqT0cxJnZKt7J5WIAb9bKUFR0O5BY_sEJf2XQM6cRLWNI315tnoO5GMuXXpeiOvsOgLYyct5FoHhaHmr00tO1a3qFx9ofx7EhRZvLvCicjgUqehXPfprIFKk6IFtqV5c-q7Wm3CmUODd2YRMWXQh4ePoEEaE4gf7tjU2RVkyvBRWDdcTh7og1aMQg7BdC8crkn3vBH7hi5Cc8AmP7ljV-1Ro1Ou5M4PrEOvDWgDxhGsdVyOue0UBcu2AyPOBqjXhnSu6drGoYO9gL3W/49b/mRArsSfJRKyw8mEX215wLQ/h1/h001.dY54WVlIzHvvYpueYPAnLmWJQLSaohC_rZhmfF9u5II)

It’s shocking that MAGA Republicans would have the audacity to claim that they care about the well-being of our nation’s children.

They’ve done nothing to protect kids from gun violence. They won’t lift a finger to fight climate change — or even admit that it’s real! They threaten to abolish the Department of Education. And they opposed expanding the child tax credit, which helped drive down child poverty by 46% when it was implemented by the Biden administration in 2021.

At Their Future PAC, we believe kids deserve a real voice in our nation’s capital. We believe that the only way to ensure kids have what they need to succeed — from proper nutrition to quality health care to good schools — is to elect leaders who put kids first.

[**With just 68 days to Election Day, we don’t have a lot of time. That’s why we MUST make every single goal from now until November 5. We know raising $16,000 this month is ambitious, but with your support today, we’ll get there!**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsm92z_9kg8EwjzhMXy50svo6CRQJo1Q8B6OnUAI0vBI49tvIyQCuYX9FdNdp_1ooNFbLUtdefyQFgRSDVsoTAXt5SUVz43MTNWMWKMmSMWhPdU5XMof_p8Q4f0jRkA0UdRlsRvPqGbaLgwgcHHlwRpnl1AM35I-YNZPLJnOnUK0-pX8k85tv7UbE_5A4X8qWxP21IlsXGzrO5FscO2bByojqaMY67oeHZCV7mzCbi3k_bS3suwzY-9O85azt-XoSFq_uuD0dRUpRefHmm58ws2MOmBlkeZXn-ZijLn_3peFdg189w8vPmhM06TOmt6g1pUC6RSkruvvIZ7EwdT0A20T6OB7DJwL9wT83z6VxX0fUCYzUlqqzgyHsLE6YtkVX6vqAF9AQs0W9PDyljv794V/49b/mRArsSfJRKyw8mEX215wLQ/h2/h001.s71iNdAxcn-R2-v6_kQIJ94CaVZfc5qFceR1eQif-QE)

Hey Peter, it’s Rep. Jamie Raskin with a critical political
message about Maryland’s future.

We need an overwhelming vote for Angela Alsobrooks as our next U.S.
Senator.

Angela is the passionate champion of the people and the experienced public
prosecutor who Maryland’s families need and deserve as our next Senator.
I’ve been proud to be supporting her campaign and walking the streets with
her for months.

But we need to talk about two other people you might be familiar with:
Larry Hogan and Donald Trump.

Larry Hogan likes to position himself somewhere between the Democratic and
Republican parties, but when he was asked if he would caucus with the
Republicans, he just laughed and said, "Of course I am. I'm a lifelong
Republican."

The problem is that this is not your grandfather’s Republican Party or
even your father’s Republican Party. This is Donald Trump’s Republican
Party.

Trump controls it completely. Either you follow orders like a sycophant or
you’re completely out in the wilderness like Vice President Mike Pence,
Adam Kinzinger, Mitt Romney and Liz Cheney, the former Chair of the House
Republican Conference.

With Larry Hogan, we’d just have another brick in the wall of support for
Senate MAGA leadership like Mitch McConnell, Ted Cruz or Josh Hawley—which
is why Trump recently endorsed Hogan’s campaign for Senate and is
promoting his campaign.

This is a momentous decision. If Larry Hogan wins, the Senate will flip
red for MAGA. And that means we all lose. Maryland loses. America loses.
American women lose.

That brings me back to the reason I’m reaching out today: I’m asking you
to lend your support to Angela Alsobrooks, a leader with courage and
conviction. A leader who’s committed to doing what’s right for
Maryland—not for Donald Trump.

Friend --
Trump is in my congressional district today, his 9th visit to Michigan since starting his 2024 presidential race – and his 3rd in just 9 days.
And while he was on stage in Potterville, Michigan, he called me out directly, saying that I am “a disaster.”
It’s not the first time that Donald Trump has come to Michigan and attacked me – in the past he’s gone as far as to call me a “far-left liberal lunatic” – and it will not be the last time. Trump also lavished praise on my opponent and made a bold prediction: that Republicans will flip this Senate seat red.
During his rally, he also claimed that the polls are rigged, attacked autoworkers, complained about slights and grievances, and undermined the sacrifices of our military and veterans. He also announced a policy to federally fund IVF treatments — despite the fact that every Republican Senate candidate (including our opponent) has refused to say if they would protect IVF federally. Even worse, my opponent, Mike Rogers, co-sponsored 4 bills that would make IVF impossible nationwide.
As I always say, watch what they do, not what they say. Mike Rogers and Donald Trump have both felt the political winds shift against them on the issue of choice, and now they are desperately hoping to persuade voters that they have changed – but Michiganders are not buying it.
We know Trump’s playbook, friend. And every time Trump returns, it is a likely boon for our potential opponent – in fundraising, in media coverage, and in volunteer activity.
We need to not only match that energy, but exceed it.
No matter what anyone may tell you, Michigan is a swing state – full stop. And just as we have swung toward Democrats, Michigan is known for swinging right on back. We can't let that happen. subject: You should make your first donation to the DNC today. Here’s why:

body:
In just a few weeks, early voting begins.
---
We have received an overwhelming number of small-dollar individual donations this election cycle. Democratic victories this November will be powered by grassroots support and we are truly proud of that fact. We hope you are too. Today is the day we need you to join those donors. Here's why: In just a few weeks, early voting begins. That means we have a number of difficult decisions we have to make about resource allocations. Because we obviously need to reach people BEFORE they vote. It's too late afterward. We have fundraising goals and targets we need to reach in order to win. Every dollar we raise toward that goal is already allocated. As we raise it, we know where it's going. But that also means that if we don't reach our goals, there are major parts of our winning program we have to pull, and that could be a disaster for Democrats in those states. Unfortunately, even a business so beloved is not immune to Democrat economic and law enforcement policies.Those same policies bring about headlines such as this: In-N-Out was forced to close its first restaurant ever because of the rampant crime in Oakland. body:

Peter, we’re at a pivotal moment.
Now more than ever, we need our government to work better and be more accountable to all Oregonians.
As the only candidate in the race to be Oregon’s next Secretary of State who has successfully managed a statewide agency, I will bring that experienced leadership to overseeing our elections and auditing state agencies.
But I can’t win this race without your support — which is why I’m reaching out to you personally.
My team is facing a major end-of-month fundraising deadline in just two days. It’s critical that we raise the funds we need to win and keep anti-democracy extremism at bay here in Oregon, so I’d be grateful if you could chip in $5, $10, or more right now to help me raise $5,000 before midnight on August 31. Can I count on you? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=240829em-eom1] [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=240819em-plan]
DONATE NOW >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=240829em-eom1]
As your next Secretary of State, I will continue to make Oregon a national leader in clean and fair elections.
And in the face of anti-democratic extremism from Donald Trump and my MAGA opponent, I will strengthen security for election workers and protect the people who make our elections run. If my opponent is elected, he has threatened to eliminate vote-by-mail elections and said he might refuse to certify the election.

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Do they think we’re stupid?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
This is not happening.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2329%2E4032634%2EVBCCA_)
---
Women are not stupid. JD Vance recently claimed that if Trump were to be president again, he would veto a national abortion ban bill. Does he really think that after they both have openly bragged about blocking access to abortion — and after Donald Trump has repeatedly bragged about how he was the one who appointed the extremist Supreme Court that got rid of Roe v. Wade — that somehow we're all going to say, “Wow, you guys are the ones to trust on this”? That's just not happening. Today, 30% of all women live in states that effectively ban abortion — something that Trump and Vance have celebrated. With them in the White House, they’ll aim for 100%. They are coming after abortion everywhere in this country. They're coming after IVF in this country, and they're coming after contraception — birth control, IUDs, Plan B, everything. Not just in red states, but nationally — red states, blue states, purple states, everywhere. They can try to soften and message test their extreme anti-abortion stances all they want, but, again, women are not stupid. And we are not going to trust the futures of our daughters and granddaughters to these two men. [**I’m going to spend the rest of this election calling out their extremist record on abortion and make sure Democrats win the White House, keep our Senate majority, and pass national abortion protections. Can you pitch in $28 or anything you can right now to power our campaign for abortion rights?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2635?amount=28&t=8&akid=2329%2E4032634%2EVBCCA_)

There’s a page in Project 2025 that covers this. It says that if Donald Trump is president, he can put in the right person over at the Department of Justice to enforce an interpretation of an old law called the Comstock Act that says you can't mail or receive any medication or any equipment that could be used in an abortion. We don’t have to guess whether or not JD Vance would follow this Project 2025 directive. Vance sent a letter last year to the Department of Justice asking them to enforce the Comstock Act. As Tim Walz says, you don’t make a playbook unless you’re planning to use it. There’s already a plan in place for this. The only way we’re going to protect access to abortion is by getting a Democratic Congress and sending a federal abortion rights bill to Kamala Harris to sign into law. Ever since Roe v. Wade was overturned, voters have been fighting back. In election after election ever since — in Kansas, in Michigan, in Ohio, in Virginia, and more — they keep reminding anti-abortion extremists how out of touch they really are. This election will be no different. But we need to fight hard for this, and put in the work now to make sure we win.
